src_lines: OM SVASTI
I bow at the feet of Holy Arya Tara.
With the merest dawning of your image
On the clean face of the pure mind's mirror,
You grant all accomplishments and siddhis.
For devotees of this profound sadhana of Arya Tara,
The Mandala, Essence of the Two Accumulations,
Ushered by the dawn-break of the thought of helping others,
The sun of Tara's elegant teachings here will rise.
lines: 為此聖度母甚深儀軌之具信者
以利他心之破曉為前導
將於此昇起度母善說之日。

src_lines: This sadhana of Queen Mother Arya Tara, the embodiment of the enlightened activity of all the conquerors of the three times is based on the mandala ritual and is an unsurpassed method for purification and amassing the two Accumulations. There are a great many practitioners with devotion for this sadhana, commonly known as the “The Tara Ritual of Four Mandalas.” With their benefit in mind, I will write a short word commentary in three sections: the preparation, the main body of practice, and the conclusion.
lines: 三世一切勝者佛行事業之化現──聖度母佛母之此儀軌，是以曼達儀軌為基礎，為清淨罪障與累積二資糧之無上法門。有許多對此儀軌深具信心的修行者，此儀軌通稱為「度母四曼達儀軌」。為了利益他們，我將分三個部分來撰寫簡明的字義釋論：前行、正行與結行。

src_lines: It is best if you have already received an empowerment specifically for Tara. If not, it is enough if you have other secret mantra empowerments and samaya. You should also have gone for refuge to the Three Jewels and purified your mind through renunciation and bodhicitta. Moreover, as the tantras say, you should “arrange the place, the companions, and the materials, then accomplish the practice in secret.”
lines: 最好您已經領受過度母專屬的灌頂。若無，只要具備其他密咒灌頂與三昧耶即可。您還應當已經皈依三寶，並透過出離心與菩提心清淨自心。此外，正如密續所言，應當「備妥處所、助伴與資具，然後於秘密中成就修持」。

src_lines: Similarly, The Adhyasaya Sutra says:
lines: 同樣地，《增上意樂經》中說：

src_lines: Move to a distance of one hundred leagues
From places of distraction and dispute.
Never spend a moment in places
Where the afflictions flourish.

It is best if you have already received an empowerment specifically for Tara. If not, it is enough if you have other secret mantra empowerments and samaya. You should also have gone for refuge to the Three Jewels and purified your mind through renunciation and bodhicitta. Moreover, as the tantras say, you should “arrange the place, the companions, and the materials, then accomplish the practice in secret.”
lines: 最好你已經領受過特別針對度母的灌頂。如果沒有，只要擁有其他密咒灌頂與三昧耶即可。你也應該已經皈依三寶，並透過出離心與菩提心來清淨自心。此外，正如密續中所說，你應當「備妥處所、助伴與資具，然後秘密地成就修持」。

src_lines: Therefore, for the beginner, the place of practice should not increase the strength of afflictions such as busyness, distraction, attachment, aversion and agitation. It is best to stay in places blessed by buddhas and bodhisattvas, or else in solitary places or mountain hermitages graced by past gurus, scholars, and siddhas. You should stay in a solitary, clean, pleasant place that augments your practice of virtue, learning, reflection, meditation, and so on.
lines: 因此，對初學者而言，修持的處所不應助長忙碌、散亂、貪戀、瞋恨與掉舉等煩惱。最好能待在諸佛菩薩加持之地，或者是過去上師、學者與成就者曾駐錫的寂靜處或山間隱修處。你應該待在寂靜、清淨、宜人，且能增進你行善以及聞、思、修等修持的處所。

src_lines: The first half of each of the first months of the four seasons,
Will bring auspiciousness, virtue, and goodness.
The full moon, new moon, and the eighth day
Will bring good omens and increase accomplishment.
lines: 四季各個初月的上半月
將帶來吉祥、美德與善好
將帶來吉兆並增長成就。

src_lines: The benefits of virtuous activities are greater during the first half of the first month of each season, on the four holy days of the Conqueror[^1], on the eighth and fifteenth days of the month, and on the new moon. On these auspicious dates and days of favorable astrological influences you will easily attain virtue, good fortune, the accomplishment of your tutelary[^2] deity, and siddhis. If you are practicing in order to pacify obstacles, diseases, and evil spirits, you should do so as they arise. If your purpose is to influence a matter of great importance, you should do the practice in the days preceding it. It also brings immeasurable benefit to recite this sadhana at random times or as a continuous, regular practice.
lines: 在四季各個初月的上半月、勝者四大節日[^1]、每月的初八和十五日，以及新月之時，行善的利益會更大。在這些吉祥的日期與星象吉兆之日，你將容易獲得美德、福報、你的本尊[^2]成就與各項成就。如果你修持的目的是為了平息障礙、疾病與邪靈，你應該在它們出現時進行修持。如果你的目的是為了對某件重大事務產生影響，你應該在此事發生之前的幾天進行修持。隨時念誦此儀軌，或將其作為持續、定期的修持，也會帶來無量的利益。

src_lines: The Summary of Sutras states, “Good disciples, respectful to their masters, should always rely on their learned gurus. Why? Because they will thereby gain the qualities of wisdom.” Therefore, your spiritual companions should be gurus and spiritual friends with pure conduct, faith, and samaya, untainted by deceptiveness, anger, and jealousy. They should be peaceful and mild, with an attitude of wanting to benefit others; they should have great faith and devotion to the pure Dharma. Your companions should also have devotion and respect for the guru and the tutelary deities. Their view and conduct should be in harmony with your own.
lines: 《集經論》記載：「敬重師長的賢善弟子，應恆常依止博學的上師。為什麼？因為他們將藉此獲得智慧的功德。」因此，你的修持同伴應是具備清淨行為、信心與三昧耶，且未受欺瞞、瞋恨與嫉妒所染的上師與法友。他們應該平靜溫和，具有想要利益他人的心；他們應對清淨正法具有極大的信心與虔敬心。你的同伴也應對上師與本尊具有虔敬與恭敬心。他們的見地與行為應該與你和諧一致。

src_lines: Clean your place of practice and make it pleasant. At first, if you have them, arrange representations of the Buddha's body, speech, and mind as a general support and, in particular, a statue or painting of Tara of good quality and correct proportions that has been consecrated. You should place on your altar a mandala made from precious metal, such as gold, silver, or copper, with a heap of grains. Although in this ritual of four mandala offerings it's said that one needs four mandalas, one for the Three Jewels in general and three to offer to Tara, one mandala will suffice for the practice. You should pleasantly and neatly arrange a kardum (a round, white torma made of the three whites[^3] and the three sweets[^4]), drinking water, water for washing feet, flowers, incense, butter lamps, scented water, food, musical instruments, and so on—whatever you can get. Likewise, collect other offerings, such as a parasol, victory banner, canopy, purification water, and grains to toss. As this practice is according to kriya tantra, you should bathe and keep things tidy and clean, if possible. If not, you should practice in the early part of the day when you have not yet been tainted by meat or alcohol.
lines: 打掃你的修法處並將其佈置得舒適宜人。首先，如果你有這些聖物，請陳設代表佛陀身、語、意的物品作為一般的所依，特別是一尊品質優良、比例正確且已開光的度母佛像或畫像。你應該在供桌上放置一個由金、銀或銅等貴金屬製成的曼達，以及一堆穀物。雖然在這個四曼達供養儀軌中，說到需要四個曼達，一個用於一般供養三寶，三個用以供養度母，但一個曼達就足以進行修持。你應該美觀而整齊地陳設一個嘎東（一種由三白[^3]與三甜[^4]製成的圓形白色食子（朵瑪））、飲水、濯足水、花、香、酥油燈、香水、食物、樂器等等──任何你能取得的供品。同樣地，備齊其他供品，例如傘蓋、勝幢、寶蓋、淨水，以及拋撒用的穀物。由於此修持依循事部，如果可以的話，你應該沐浴並保持整潔與清淨。如果無法做到，你應該在一天中較早的時間進行修持，此時你尚未沾染肉類或酒類。

src_lines: First you go for refuge with a single-minded attitude of faith and devotion. The gateway to all Buddhist paths is refuge. Particularly in the Mahayana tradition, the root of the path is the generation of bodhicitta. Therefore, in the beginning you should go for refuge and generate bodhicitta.
lines: 首先，你以專一的信心與虔敬心來皈依。一切佛道的門戶即是皈依。尤其在大乘傳統中，修道的根本就是生起菩提心。因此，一開始你應該皈依並生起菩提心。

src_lines: In the space before me is the Holy Lady manifest.
lines: 於我前方虛空中，聖度母正顯現。

src_lines: Firmly believing that Tara is really there, envision the objects of refuge as follows. In the space before you, in the center of clouds of offerings, rainbow light, and flowers, upon a lotus and a full moon disc, imagine that the essence of all the objects of refuge is manifest in the aspect of the Holy Lady Arya Tara. The embodiment of love and compassion, she is beautiful with a turquoise radiance. She is adorned with various ornaments and her lovely face bears a smile. She bears witness to your taking refuge. It is the nature of things that if one envisions the buddhas with single-minded faith and devotion, they will actually come. As mentioned in the sutras, “The Lord of Sages will always remain before whosoever turns her mind towards him.”
lines: 堅信度母真實安住於該處，並如下觀想皈依境。在你前方的虛空中，在供雲、虹光與鮮花的中央，於蓮花與滿月輪上，觀想所有皈依境的本質化現為聖度母的形相。作為慈愛與悲心的體現，她帶著綠松石般的光輝，美麗動人。她佩戴著各種莊嚴飾品，美麗的面孔帶著微笑。她在此為你的皈依作見證。萬法的本性即是如此，如果以專一的信心與虔敬心觀想諸佛，諸佛便會真實降臨。正如經典所記載：「任何人只要將心轉向能仁尊，能仁尊將恆常安住於其前方。」

src_lines: Therefore, leading all other sentient beings before the refuge Arya Tara, with tremendous devotion, go for refuge with your three doors: prostrate respectfully with your body, supplicate respectfully with your speech, and respectfully give rise to faith with your mind.
lines: 因此，帶領所有其他眾生來到作為皈依境的聖度母前，以極大的虔敬心，以你的三門來皈依：身恭敬頂禮，語恭敬祈請，意恭敬生起信心。

src_lines: Namo! I and all sentient beings go for refuge
To the Holy Lady, Three Jewels' embodiment.

These lines represent actually going for refuge. Namo is a Sanskrit term meaning reverence or prostration. Since you go for refuge reverently you must know whom you are revering—that is, you must identify the objects of refuge. The common objects of refuge are known as the Three Precious Jewels: the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha. In the Vajrayana path of secret mantra we add to these the Three Roots: the guru, the tutelary deity, and the dakinis. You agree to go for refuge along with all beings of the six realms by saying, “From now until we attain enlightenment, we go for refuge to the Holy Arya Tara, complete embodiment of the host of deities of the Three Roots.” Moreover, with an attitude of complete trust and surrender, you should think, “From now on, whatever happens, good or bad, happy or sad, I will neither take refuge nor place my hopes in anyone but you, Arya Tara.”
lines: 這些偈頌代表真實的皈依。Namo 是一個梵文詞彙，意思是恭敬或頂禮。既然你恭敬地皈依，你必須知道你所恭敬的對象是誰──也就是說，你必須認明皈依境。共同的皈依境被稱為三寶：佛、法、僧。在秘密咒金剛乘的修道中，我們在此之上加入了三根本：上師、本尊與空行母。你藉由念誦：「從現在起直到我們證得證悟為止，我們皈依三根本聖眾的總集──聖度母」，來應允與六道一切眾生共同皈依。此外，以完全信任與臣服的心態，你應該想：「從今以後，無論發生什麼事，是好是壞，是悲是喜，除了妳，聖度母，我不會向任何人皈依，也不會將希望寄託於任何人。」

src_lines: Generally, regarding the Three Jewels, you go for refuge to the Buddha as the teacher who shows you the path to attaining freedom, to the Dharma as the actual path to attaining freedom, and to the Sangha as the friends who help you attain freedom. That is because the Three Jewels are infallible, respectively, as the teacher of the authentic path, the path to freedom, and the friends who help you attain freedom; no one else has the ability to usher you to liberation. You take refuge until you attain the state of buddhahood. As for why, you do so in order that all sentient beings, yourself and others, once freed from the fears of samsara, may attain the ultimate liberation. The purpose and benefit of taking refuge are that it is the entrance gate to the Buddhist path. Lord Atisha said, “Refuge distinguishes the Buddhist from the non-Buddhist.” Refuge is also the foundation for all vows and the root of all paths to freedom. Thus, by taking refuge, you are counted as a Buddhist and will be protected and nurtured by the Three Jewels. Nor will you be beset by obstacles, but will set out on the path to freedom.
lines: 總的來說，關於三寶，你皈依佛，將其視為為你指示解脫之道的導師；皈依法，將其視為獲致解脫的真實道路；皈依僧，將其視為幫助你獲致解脫的道友。這是因為三寶分別作為真實修道的導師、解脫之道以及幫助你獲致解脫的道友，是無欺的；沒有其他人有能力引導你邁向解脫。你皈依直到證得佛果為止。至於為什麼這麼做，是為了讓自他一切眾生在從輪迴的恐懼中解脫出來後，能夠獲致究竟的解脫。皈依的目的與利益在於它是進入佛道的門戶。阿底峽尊者曾說：「皈依區分了佛教徒與非佛教徒。」皈依也是一切戒律的基礎，以及一切解脫之道的根本。因此，藉由皈依，你便算是一名佛教徒，並將受到三寶的保護與護念。你也不會被障礙所困，而是將踏上解脫之道。

src_lines: Having given rise to bodhicitta of
Aspiration, I will enter the path profound.

These two lines represent the generation of bodhicitta, the mind of enlightenment. Here, the meaning of the generation of the mind of supreme enlightenment is the motivation that thinks, “In order to place all sentient beings, my fathers and mothers, in the state of everlasting happiness, buddhahood, I will practice the profound path of Tara's sadhanas.” The meaning of the term “bodhicitta” is explained in Maitreya's Ornament of Realization: “Bodhicitta is to want complete, perfect enlightenment for the sake of others.” Therefore bodhicitta is the mind that wishes to attain the state of buddhahood for the sake of other beings. There are two kinds of bodhicitta: aspirational bodhicitta and engaged bodhicitta. Of these two, I have been referring of aspirational bodhicitta. Engaged bodhicitta is not just about striving for buddhahood for the sake of other sentient beings, but also about accomplishing the actual paths through practice. Another way of explaining this is that while aspirational bodhicitta is a kindhearted attitude focused on others, actually accomplishing their benefit is engaged bodhicitta. Bodhicitta is not just the point of entry to the way of Mahayana, it is also the foundation of the Mahayana paths. It is also said that bodhicitta differentiates the Mahayana from the Hinayana. All the roots of virtue embraced by bodhicitta increase without ever being exhausted. They become the cause of buddhahood and bring complete benefit to others. Thus, as it has countless benefits, it is essential to practice bodhicitta.
lines: 這兩句偈頌代表發起菩提心，即證悟之心。在此，發起殊勝證悟之心的意義在於生起這樣的動機：「為了將我的一切父母眾生安置於永恆安樂的佛果境界，我將修持度母成就法的深邃道。」彌勒菩薩的《現觀莊嚴論》中解釋了「菩提心」一詞的意義：「菩提心就是為了利益他人而希求完全、圓滿的證悟。」因此，菩提心就是為了其他眾生的利益而希求證得佛果境界的心。菩提心有兩種：願菩提心與行菩提心。在這兩者之中，我剛才所指的是願菩提心。行菩提心不僅是為了其他眾生而努力追求佛果，也是透過修持來成就真實的修道。另一種解釋方式是，雖然願菩提心是一種專注於他人的仁善態度，但實際成就他們的利益則是行菩提心。菩提心不僅是進入大乘之道的門戶，也是大乘修道的基礎。也有一說，菩提心區分了大乘與小乘。所有被菩提心所攝持的善根，都會不斷增長而永不耗盡。它們將成為佛果的因，並為他人帶來圓滿的利益。因此，由於它具有無數的利益，修持菩提心是至關重要的。

src_lines: With total faith I pay homage
To Holy Arya Tara and
All the conquerors and their heirs
In ten directions and three times.

You and all sentient beings are the ones paying homage. They to whom you pay homage are the twenty-one Taras, all gurus, and the conquerors together with their heirs that dwell in all times, in all places, in all directions. The ten directions are the four cardinal directions, the four ordinal directions, above, and below. The three times are past, present, and future, but for brevity's sake we say, “in all times, in all places, in all directions.” You prostrate single-mindedly with total faith and devotion to the objects of homage. The “total” in “total faith” refers to the manner in which you pay homage: with all three doors of body, speech and mind. Homage is the antidote to the affliction of pride.
lines: 你與一切眾生是頂禮者。你所頂禮的對象是二十一度母、一切上師，以及安住於一切時間、一切地點、一切方向的勝者與其佛子。十方是指四正方、四隅方，以及上方與下方。三世是指過去、現在與未來，但為了簡潔起見，我們說「於一切時間、一切地點、一切方向」。你以全然的信心與虔敬，專一地向頂禮境頂禮。「全然的信心」中的「全然」是指你頂禮的方式：以身、語、意三門來頂禮。頂禮是對治我慢煩惱的解藥。

src_lines: I make offerings, real and mental,
Of flowers, incense, butter lamps,
Of perfumes, food, music, and more;
Noble Assembly, please accept them.

You should offer whatever you may have, such as flowers, incense, and so forth. Make imagined offerings as well of beautiful flowers, sweet-smelling incense, radiant butter lamps, delicious foods, and melodious music—offerings so vast they pervade the totality of space. Mainly offer these, the objects of the five senses, but also offer everything in the whole billionfold universe to the twenty-one Arya Taras, thinking, “Please accept them out of your great compassion so that I and all sentient beings may complete the accumulations.” Offering is the antidote to the affliction of miserliness.
lines: 你應該供養任何你所擁有的物品，例如鮮花、妙香等等。也要作意觀的供養，供養美麗的鮮花、芬芳的妙香、明亮的酥油燈、美味的飲食與悅耳的音樂——這些供品極其廣大，遍滿了整個虛空。主要供養這些五種感官的對境，但也要將整個三千大千世界中的一切供養給二十一聖度母，心中想著：「為了讓我與一切眾生圓滿二資糧，請以大悲心納受它們。」供養是對治慳吝煩惱的解藥。

src_lines: I confess all misdeeds I have done,
My mind beneath the power of afflictions,
From time beginningless until right now,
The ten nonvirtues and five immediates.[^5]

Before the supreme, holy field of merit, you and all other sentient beings confess the ten non-virtues, which you have been committing since beginningless time—the three non-virtues of the body (killing, stealing, and sexual misconduct), the four non-virtues of speech (lying, divisive speech, harsh speech, and meaningless chatter), the three non-virtues of the mind (covetousness, malice, and wrong view); also confess the five actions of immediate retribution (patricide, matricide, killing an arhat, creating schism in the Sangha, and drawing a buddha’s blood with bad intent) and afflictions like attachment, anger, pride, ignorance, hatred, jealousy, and so forth. In short, you confess all non-virtuous deeds, which are products of the afflictions. When you confess your misdeeds with the four powers and a strong sense of shame and regret, they will be purified. It is said, “The one good quality of misdeeds is that they will be purified if you confess them.” Confession is an antitode to misdeeds in general, but mainly to hatred.
lines: 在殊勝、神聖的福田前，你與一切其他眾生懺悔自無始以來所造作的十不善業——身的三不善（殺生、偷盜與邪淫）、語的四不善（妄語、兩舌、惡口與綺語）、意的三不善（貪欲、瞋恚與邪見）；也懺悔五無間罪（殺父、殺母、殺阿羅漢、破和合僧與惡心出佛身血）以及貪、瞋、慢、癡、恨、嫉等煩惱。簡而言之，你懺悔一切不善業，這些都是煩惱的產物。當你以四力，並帶著強烈的慚愧與悔恨心來懺悔罪業時，它們就會被清淨。有言道：「罪業唯一的優點，就是若你懺悔，便能將之清淨。」懺悔一般是對治罪業的解藥，但主要對治的是瞋恨。

src_lines: I rejoice in all merits and virtues
Collected in the three times by
Hearers, solitary buddhas,
Bodhisattvas, and common beings.

Before Arya Tara and the field of merit, rejoice in all the merit of others and in the results of their virtue, the happiness of higher birth and the highest good[^6]. Rejoice also in the all the qualities and merits of the hearers, solitary buddhas, and bodhisattvas—noble beings who have actualized the results of the three vehicles. Rejoice wholeheartedly in all the virtuous causes which bring about joyful results for ordinary beings, their virtues and merits in all three times, their abundance and wealth, their bodies and health. In short, rejoice in all their goodness and good qualities.
lines: 在聖度母與福田前，隨喜他人的一切福德與其善業的果報，亦即增上生與決定勝的安樂[^6]。也要隨喜聲聞、緣覺與菩薩——這些已證得三乘果位的聖者們——的所有功德與福德。全心全意地隨喜為凡夫眾生帶來喜悅果報的一切善因、他們在三世中的善業與福德、他們的豐饒與財富，以及他們的身體與健康。簡而言之，隨喜他們一切的善好與功德。

src_lines: As for the benefits of rejoicing:
If, abandoning the wicked mind of jealousy,
You rejoice with heartfelt gladness
On hearing of others' virtuous deeds,
You will gain merit equal to theirs, it is said.

Rejoicing is the antidote to jealousy. There is no good reason to be jealous and no benefit comes from it. It not only makes you unhappy, it also causes unhappiness for others. Be careful, or else jealousy will cause much suffering for you and others in lives to come.
lines: 隨喜是嫉妒的對治法。嫉妒沒有任何充分的理由，也無法帶來任何益處。它不僅使你不快樂，也會使他人不快樂。要小心，否則嫉妒會在來世為你與他人帶來許多痛苦。

src_lines: In accordance with the different minds
And mentalities of sentient beings,
Please turn the wheel of Dharma of
The greater, lesser, and common vehicles.

Thus pray that the buddhas, bodhisattvas, gurus, and spiritual friends turn the wheel of Dharma of the Mahayana and the Hinayana, giving every kind of teaching specifically according to the dispositions, interests, and different mentalities of the beings who are to be tamed.
lines: 因此，祈請諸佛、菩薩、上師與善知識轉動大乘與小乘法輪，具體根據所化眾生的根性、意樂與不同心性，給予各種教法。

src_lines: I beseech you, do not pass into
Nirvana until samsara empties out,
But with compassion look on beings who
Are drowning in this sea of suffering.

Thus beseech the buddhas, bodhisattvas, gurus, and spiritual friends who wish to pass into nirvana not to do so until samsara empties out, but to look with compassion on you and others who, tormented by the three sufferings, drown in the ocean of samsara, and to place you all in higher rebirths and the state of the highest good.
lines: 因此，祈請欲入涅槃之諸佛、菩薩、上師與善知識，直至輪迴空盡之前切莫入於涅槃，而是以慈悲眷顧受三苦折磨、沉淪於輪迴苦海的你與其他眾生，並將你們全安置於善趣與至善之境。

src_lines: May whatever merit I have gathered
All become the cause of enlightenment,
And, without any more delay, may I
Become a glorious guide for wanderers.

“Whatever merit I have gathered” means the virtues that come from gathering merit and purifying obscurations by means of the seven branch prayer, which you have just recited. This merit stands for the collection of all the merit that you and everyone else have gathered throughout the three times. May all these roots of virtue become the cause of perfect enlightenment, and, without any more delay, may you become the protector, refuge, and guide who leads all sentient beings on the perfect path. Having attained the state of buddhahood, may you perform the benefit of beings for as long as space endures.
lines: 「願我所集諸福德」是指藉由你剛剛念誦的七支供養，積聚福德與淨除障礙所產生的善德。此福德代表你與所有人於三世中所積聚的一切福德總集。願所有這些善根皆成為圓滿菩提之因，並祈願你毫不遲延地，成為引導一切眾生走上圓滿道路的怙主、皈依處與導師。證得佛果後，只要虛空猶存，願你皆能持續利益眾生。

src_lines: After completing the accumulations through the seven-branch prayer, bless the offerings with the mantra of the wrathful Amrita Kundali:
lines: 藉由七支供養圓滿資糧後，以忿怒甘露軍荼利咒加持供品：

src_lines: OM BENZA AMRITA KÜNDALI HANA HANA HÜNG PET
lines: OM BENZA AMRITA KÜNDALI HANA HANA HÜNG PET

src_lines: Then recite:
OM SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO SAR WA DHARMA SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO HAM
lines: OM SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO SAR WA DHARMA SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO HAM

src_lines: Imagining that this mantra purifies the impure stains of greed and clinging to phenomena as real. Then sprinkling water, all outer and inner phenomena are purified into emptiness.
lines: 應觀想此咒語淨化了貪欲與執著諸法為實有的不淨垢染。接著灑水，內外一切諸法皆清淨為空性。

src_lines: Then:
This place becomes the Lotus Arrangement Field
Adorned with shapes in measureless array.
Formed by samadhi, substances divine
Turn into thought-unfathomed offerings.

From the state of emptiness, this outer place, being no ordinary dwelling place or environment, is Arya Tara's pure land Lotus Arrangement of Great Bliss and its celestial mansion. Its shapes and ornamentation are marvelous; their measure and limits cannot be grasped by the mind. Imagine that drinking water, water for washing feet, flowers, incense, butter lamps, scented water, food, music, and so forth; all untainted, divine offerings produced by samadhi; the objects of the five senses as well; the eight auspicious symbols; the seven royal possessions; parasols; and victory banners—offerings of all the riches and wonders there are whatsoever in samsara or nirvana—completely fill all directions, places, realms, and all of space.
lines: 從空性之中，這個外在的處所並非一般的住所或環境，而是聖度母的大樂蓮花莊嚴淨土及其無量宮。其形相與裝飾奇妙無比；其廣大與邊際非心所能測度。應觀想飲水、濯足水、花、香、酥油燈、塗香、飲食、音樂等；所有由三摩地所生、無垢的神聖供品；以及五根之對境；八吉祥、七政寶、寶傘與勝幢──輪迴與涅槃中任何一切財富與奇妙事物之供品──完全遍滿十方、一切處所、一切界以及整個虛空。

src_lines: Then recite the offering mantra.
OM BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA
WI DYA / SHAB DA AH HÜNG
lines: OM BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA
WI DYA / SHAB DA AH HÜNG

src_lines: Then:
OM BENZA SAPARANA KAM
The meaning of this mantra is “May the clouds of offerings, drinking water, etc. never be exhausted.”
lines: 這句咒語的意思是：「願飲水等供養雲無有窮盡。」

src_lines: At the beginning of offering the four mandalas, you offer the first one to the Three Jewels in general. Just as with the homage and previous offerings, the object of the mandala offering is the field of merit. Recite the evocation:
lines: 在開始獻四曼達時，你要將第一個曼達獻給總體的三寶。就如頂禮與先前的供養一般，獻曼達的對象也是福田。念誦迎請文：

src_lines: All gurus, conquerors, and their heirs of the ten directions and four times are in the space before me. BENZA SA MA DZA.
lines: 十方四時一切上師、勝者與佛子，安住於我前方虛空中。BENZA SA MA DZA。

src_lines: The ten directions are the four cardinal directions, the four ordinal directions, above, and below. The four times are the conventional three times of the past, present, and future, plus the ultimate time— that is, the time of evenness that, by virtue of emptiness, the ultimate mode of being, is beyond all time. As you utter BENZA SAMADZA, the mantra of evocation, all the gurus and spiritual friends throughout the four times, who show us the faults to abandon and the qualities to accept; the buddhas who are victorious over the afflictions, the two obscurations, and the four maras; the heirs of the buddhas, the bodhisattvas; and the hearers and solitary buddhas appear in the space before you. Having uttered the mantra with single-minded faith and yearning, recite:
lines: 十方是指四正方、四維，以及上方與下方。四時是指世俗的過去、現在、未來三時，加上勝義時——亦即藉由空性這個究竟實相，而超越一切時間的平等時。當你念誦迎請咒 BENZA SAMADZA 時，為我們開示應斷過失與應取功德的四時一切上師與善知識；戰勝煩惱、二障與四魔的諸佛；諸佛之子，也就是菩薩們；以及聲聞、緣覺，皆顯現於你前方的虛空中。以專一的信心與渴慕念誦此咒後，念誦：

src_lines: Protectors of all sentient beings without exception,
Deities who overcome the maras and their hosts,
You who know all things whatever as they are,
Pray come here with your retinues, Oh Blessed Ones!
PEMA KA MA LA YA SA TAM
lines: PEMA KA MA LA YA SA TAM

src_lines: For the benefit of others, the buddhas are the refuge and protectors of all sentient beings without exception, for they have completely abandoned the partiality of closeness to friends and superiors and distance from enemies and inferiors. For their own benefit, they are supreme deities who destroyed all the maras—that is the afflictions, self-grasping, the two obscurations, and the hosts of maras. The buddhas, the Blessed Ones, know precisely the mode of being and mode of appearance of all things, of all phenomena whatsoever. With single-minded faith and yearning, pray that they come to the place where you are making offerings. Thus praying, you invite the buddhas. Then recite, “PEMA KAMALA YA SATAM,” which means “Please stay here on this lotus throne.” Imagine that the conquerors come to the space in front of you and sit on lotuses and other plush, luxurious thrones. Then, in their presence recite the seven-branch prayer to amass the accumulations.
lines: 為了利他，諸佛是無餘一切眾生的皈依處與怙主，因為他們已經完全捨棄了親近親友與尊長、疏遠仇敵與下劣者的偏頗。為了自利，他們是摧毀一切魔——亦即煩惱、我執、二障以及魔軍——的無上尊。諸佛，亦即世尊，確切了知所有一切事物、一切萬法的實相與現相。以專一的信心與渴慕，祈請他們降臨你作供養的所在之處。藉由如此祈請，你迎請了諸佛。接著念誦：「PEMA KAMALA YA SATAM」，意思是「請安住於此蓮花座上」。應觀想勝者們降臨你前方的虛空中，並安坐於蓮花及其他柔軟舒適、華麗的寶座上。然後，在他們面前念誦七支供養以累積資糧。

src_lines: First you pay homage:
With purity in body, speech and mind
I pay homage to all the lions of men,
However many exist in the three times
In all the worlds that are in ten directions.

“In all worlds that are in ten directions” means limitless. “In the three times” refers to the buddhas who came in the past, those who will come in the future, and those who are presently coming. “Lions of men” means that just as the lion is the supreme king of the animals, the buddhas are supreme among humans. “However many exist” means that you respectfully pay homage with body, speech, and mind to every buddha whatsoever.
lines: 「於十方一切世界中」意指無量。「三世」是指過去已降臨、未來將降臨，以及現在正降臨的諸佛。「人中獅」是指正如獅子是百獸之王，諸佛亦是人中至尊。「所有一切」是指你以身、語、意恭敬地頂禮每一尊佛。

src_lines: Then pay homage specifically with your body:
By virtue of my aspiration to good conduct,
May all the conquerors come clearly to my mind.
I pay homage to them all, prostrating with
As many bodies as there are atoms in the world.
lines: 願一切勝者明現於我心
我向彼等一切頂禮，並化現出
等同世界微塵數之身軀作禮拜。

src_lines: Here you pay homage to the buddhas, who are the conquerors of the maras, afflictions, and so on. “By virtue of my aspiration to good conduct” means by virtue of the bodhisattvas' conduct and aspirations. By that power you will see the conquerors clearly; alternately, imagine or believe that they are actually before you. Then, emanating or imagining bodies equal in number to the atoms of all worlds, prostrate sincerely before each of them.
lines: 在此，你要向諸佛頂禮，他們是降伏魔障、煩惱等之勝者。「藉由我普賢行願之力」是指藉由菩薩的行持與發願之力。藉由此力量，你將清晰地見到諸勝者；或者，觀想或深信他們實際上就在你面前。接著，化現或觀想等同一切世界微塵數的身軀，在每一尊佛面前真誠地頂禮。

src_lines: Then pay homage with your mind:
I imagine the assembled buddhas,
As many as are atoms, on each atom,
Abiding in the midst of all their heirs,
The dharmadhatu filled with conquerors.
lines: 於每一微塵有微塵數之佛

src_lines: In the dharmata, buddhas equal in number to all the particles in existence, both fine and coarse, are gathered on each particle. That they are equal in number to all particles means that there are countless buddhas. Imagine that the buddhas abiding amidst their heirs, the bodhisattvas, fill the infinite, measureless dharmadhatu. With your mind, pay homage to them with confident faith.
lines: 於法性中，數量等同所有粗細微塵的諸佛，聚集在每一微塵上。他們的數量等同所有微塵，這意味著有著無數的諸佛。觀想安住於其佛子（菩薩）眾中的諸佛，充滿了無限、無量的法界。以你的意，帶著堅定的信心向他們頂禮。

src_lines: Finally pay homage through speech:
I proclaim the conquerors' qualities
And sing the praises of the bliss-gone ones
With all the sounds that fill an ocean of
Diverse tunes, an endless sea of praise.

Here you are paying homage with speech to the buddhas, who have obtained the result, the state of sugata, or bliss-gone one, by relying on the cause, the path of the ones gone to bliss. With a vast ocean of gentle melodies, sweet voices, and endless sounds, proclaim the profound qualities of all the conquerors and sing the sea of praises of all the bliss-gone ones.
lines: 這裡是以語向諸佛頂禮，諸佛藉由依止其因──趨至大樂者之道，而獲得了其果──「善逝」或稱趨至大樂者之境地。應以廣大汪洋般柔美的旋律、甜美的音色與無盡的音聲，宣揚一切勝者之甚深功德，並唱頌對一切善逝的如海讚歎。

src_lines: The second branch, offering, has two aspects: ordinary offerings and extraordinary offerings.
lines: 第二支「供養」有兩個層面：一般供養與不共供養。

src_lines: Concerning the ordinary offerings the text says:
lines: 關於一般供養，文中說道：

src_lines: I make offerings to the conquerors
Of exquisite flowers, precious garlands,
Cymbals, unguents, and fine parasols,
The best of lamps, the finest incenses;
I make offerings to the conquerors
Of all the finest clothing, fragrances,
And powders piled up to Meru's heights
And in the most resplendent of arrangements.

Here you are offering to the assembly of the conquerors and their heirs beautiful flowers, precious garlands, sweet music, aromatic perfumes, parasols made from all kinds of fine materials, bright lamps, fragrant incense of both naturally occurring and prepared varieties and so forth. You also offer beautifully colored, fine, soft clothing, unguents of various sweet smells, and piles of powder made from saffron and sandalwood, as high as Mount Meru. Give all of these excellent offerings to the conquerors and their heirs in clean, pleasant, and beautiful arrangements.
lines: 在這裡，你要向勝者與其佛子眾供養美麗的花朵、珍貴的花鬘、悅耳的音樂、芳香的香水、各種上好材質製成的傘蓋、明亮的燈盞、天然生成與人工調製的芬芳香品等等。你還供養色彩美麗、精緻柔軟的衣物，各種氣味芬芳的塗香，以及由紅花與檀香製成、堆積如須彌山般高的香末。將所有這些殊勝供品，以清淨、悅意且美麗的陳列方式，獻給勝者與其佛子眾。

src_lines: Then, concerning the extraordinary offering, it says:
lines: 接著，關於不共供養，文中說道：

src_lines: For all the conquerors, I imagine
These vast and incomparable offerings.
By virtue of my faith in wholesome conduct,
I prostrate and make offerings to them.

The offerings created through the aspirations and samadhi of the bodhisattvas, heirs of the conquerors, are the best of offerings. These offerings are incomparable because no other offerings can match them. Therefore, they extend unceasing throughout all directions and times. Pay homage and offer this vastness to all the conquerors through the power of your devotion and your faith in wholesome conduct.
lines: 菩薩（勝者之佛子）透過發願與三摩地所化現的供品，是最殊勝的供品。這些供品是無與倫比的，因為沒有其他任何供品能與之相比。因此，它們在十方三世中綿延不絕。你應透過虔敬心以及對善行深信的力量，向一切勝者頂禮，並獻上此廣大的供養。

src_lines: The third branch concerns the confession of misdeeds:
lines: 第三支是關於懺悔罪業：

src_lines: Whatever misdeeds I have done
With body, speech, or mind due to
Attachment, hatred, or delusion,
I confess them, every one.

Urged on by the three poisons—the cause, the afflictions of attachment, hatred, and delusion— whatever misdeeds of body, speech, or mind that you yourself have done, forced others to do, or rejoiced in others doing: confess them all, each and every one.
lines: 受三毒──也就是作為因的貪、瞋、癡等煩惱──所驅使，無論是你自己以身、語、意所造作的，或是迫使他人造作、隨喜他人造作的任何罪業：你都必須將它們全部一一懺悔。

src_lines: The fourth branch is rejoicing:
I rejoice in all the merit of
The ten directions' conquerors, their heirs,
Of lone buddhas, learners, no-more-learners,
And every wanderer without exception.

With an attitude of gladness and enthusiasm, you should rejoice in all the happiness, virtue, and merit of all beings whatsoever—of the conquerors dwelling in the ten directions; of the bodhisattvas, heart children of the buddhas; of the buddhas' speech-children: those arhats who are solitary buddhas and those who are hearers, and those who are learning and those who are no longer learning; and of wanderers or ordinary beings.
lines: 你應以歡喜與熱忱的心態，隨喜任何眾生的一切安樂、善行與福德──無論是安住十方的諸勝者；佛陀的心子諸菩薩；佛陀的語子：即緣覺與聲聞阿羅漢，以及有學與無學聖者；或是諸眾生與凡夫。

src_lines: The fifth branch is the request to turn the wheel of Dharma:
Lamps of all the worlds of ten directions,
You protectors who, without desire,
Gained buddhahood by stages—I request
You all to turn the matchless Dharma wheel.

The conquerors are the lamps that perfectly show the path to beings in all the worlds of the ten directions, who are obscured by the dense darkness of ignorance about what to accept or reject. Request or supplicate all the protectors—the buddhas or blessed ones who traveled the path to enlightenment in stages and, without desire, gained the state of buddhahood—to turn the unsurpassed Dharma wheel.
lines: 諸勝者即是明燈，為十方一切世界中、被不知取捨的無明濃重黑暗所障蔽的眾生，圓滿指明道路。祈請或懇求一切護尊──也就是漸次行於覺悟之道、無有貪欲而證得佛果境界的諸佛或世尊──轉動無上法輪。

src_lines: The sixth branch is praying to the buddhas not to pass into nirvana:
lines: 第六支是祈請諸佛不入涅槃：

src_lines: With palms conjoined, I pray to you who wish
To show your passing to nirvana, stay
For beings' benefit and happiness
For eons many as atoms in the world.

For the temporary benefit and ultimate happiness of all this world's wanderers to be tamed, press your palms together and with single-minded faith and yearning pray to those buddhas and bodhisattvas who wish to display their passing into nirvana not to do so, but to remain for eons equal in number to the particles in the world.
lines: 為了讓這世間一切所化眾生獲得暫時的利益與究竟的安樂，應雙手合掌，以專一的信心與渴仰，祈請那些欲示現入於涅槃的諸佛菩薩不要入滅，而是安住等同於世間微塵數量的劫數。

src_lines: The seventh and final branch is dedication:
lines: 第七也是最後一支是迴向：

src_lines: Whatever meager virtue I have gathered
Through homage, offering, confession, and
Rejoicing, requesting, and prayer—every virtue
I dedicate for full enlightenment.
lines: 隨喜請轉與祈願──一切善德

src_lines: Here you dedicate whatever meager roots of virtue you have gained through homage to the great conquerors, offering, confession of misdeeds, rejoicing in the merit of others, entreating the buddhas to turn the wheel of Dharma, praying that they to remain and not pass into nirvana, and so on. This represents all the merit accumulated in the three times by yourself and others. As for why, you dedicate the merit for the sake of winning the state of complete enlightenment. The way to dedicate merit is with the wisdom of emptiness that is pure of the three spheres.
lines: 在此，你將藉由頂禮諸大勝者、供養、懺悔罪業、隨喜他人福德、勸請諸佛轉法輪、祈願諸佛住世而不入涅槃等等，所獲得的任何微少善根，皆予以迴向。這代表了你自己與他人於三世所累積的一切福德。至於為何如此，你迴向福德是為了獲得圓滿菩提的果位。迴向福德的方式，是以三輪體空的空性智慧來進行。

src_lines: Now that you have made the offering of the seven branches, you make a mandala offering to the Three Jewels in general.
lines: 現在你已經完成了七支供養，接著要向總體的三寶獻曼達。

src_lines: OM AH HUNG
Having been blessed in terms of purification, transformation, and increase[^7] by this life-force mantra of body, speech, and mind, offer the following.
lines: 藉由此身語意之命咒，在淨化、轉化與增長[^7]方面獲得加持後，獻上以下供養。

src_lines: I and sentient beings without count,
Having emanated constantly
All our bodies, wealth, and gathered virtue,
The four continents, Meru, sun and moon,
The thought-unfathomed wealth of gods and humans,
Samantabhadra's massive offering clouds,

You and all countless beings offer your bodies, which you have grasped as I; your wealth and gathered virtue, which you have grasped as mine; the four continents—Purvavideha in the east, Jambudvipa in the south, Aparagodaniya in the west, and Uttarakuru in the north—the billion islands, the Mount Meru of the great billionfold universe, the Sea of Enjoyment, and the sun and moon. You offer the inexhaustible wealth, fortune, and glory of the gods, nagas, and humans. Offer also the hard to fathom, cloud-like offerings of Samantabhadra.
lines: 你與所有無數眾生供養你們執著為「我」的身體；執著為「我的」財富與所聚善根；四大部洲——東方的東勝神洲、南方的南贍部洲、西方的西牛賀洲與北方的北俱盧洲——十億小洲、三千大千世界的須彌山、受用海，以及日月。你們供養天、龍與人無盡的財富、福報與榮耀。也供養難以思議、如雲般的普賢菩薩供養。

src_lines: As for those to whom you make this vast and ceaselessly emanated mandala offering:
lines: 至於你獻上這廣大且不斷化現之曼達的供養對象：

src_lines: To the Three Jewels, the precious Three Roots, and
The sea of dharmapalas and wealth deities,

The precious Three Jewels are the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha. The Three Roots are the guru, root of blessings; the tutelary deity, root of siddhis; and the dakinis, root of activity. The ocean of deities is the gods, nagas, etc. on the side of virtue, the protectors who guard the Dharma, and the wealth deities who grant the siddhi of inexhaustible riches.
lines: 珍貴的三寶即是佛、法、僧。三根本即是加持的根本──上師；成就的根本──本尊；以及事業的根本──空行母。如海的尊眾即是善方的天、龍等，守護佛法的護法，以及賜予無盡財富成就的財神。

src_lines: Concerning the manner in which you make offerings:
We offer them respectfully and always.
This massive gathering of merit finished,
May the light of primordial wisdom grow.
OM GÜRÜ DEWA DAKINI SARWA RATNA MANDALA PÜDZA MEGHA AH HÜNG
lines: OM GÜRÜ DEWA DAKINI SARWA RATNA MANDALA PÜDZA MEGHA AH HÜNG

src_lines: You make offerings faithfully and respectfully with body, speech, and mind always, without ceasing. As you have now utterly completed the vast accumulation of merit—the method—may the light of the accumulation of primordial wisdom grow. In other words, in dependence on the immense gathering of merit you've amassed by offering the mandala, may the light of the primordial wisdom that realizes the mode of being of phenomena grow in your mindstream. Then, after reciting the mantra of the mandala offering, you should offer the mandala and toss some grains in the air. Generally speaking, the mandala offering is easy to do and yields huge benefit. It is the best way to complete the great accumulation of merit quickly. The sutras say, “Because they have merit, all their wishes are fulfilled.” Similarly, if you strive in the practice of the mandala, you will have longevity, merit, glory, wealth, power, and fame in this life. What's more, experience and realization, love and compassion will be born in your mindstream, and in future lives, you will have the short-term pleasure and comfort of the gods and humans in the higher realms. Then, gradually, with greater and greater realizations on the grounds and paths, you will at last obtain unimagined qualities, the matchless result of the two accumulations—the form body adorned with the marks of a buddha and the dharma body, which is the very essence of stainless primordial wisdom.
lines: 你恆常不息地以身、語、意，充滿信心與恭敬地獻上供養。既然你現在已經徹底圓滿廣大的福德資糧──即方便，願本初智資糧之光增長。換言之，依靠你藉由獻曼達所積累的浩瀚福德聚，願了悟諸法實相的本初智之光在你的相續中增長。然後，在念誦完獻曼達的咒語後，你應當獻上曼達，並向空中拋灑穀米。一般而言，獻曼達易於修持，且能帶來巨大的利益。這是迅速圓滿廣大福德資糧的最佳方法。經典中說：「因為具有福德，他們的一切願望皆能實現。」同樣地，如果你精勤修持曼達，今生將會獲得長壽、福德、榮耀、財富、權力與名望。此外，你的相續中將會生起覺受與證悟、慈愛與悲心，而在未來的生生世世中，你將獲得善趣天與人短暫的安樂與舒適。接著，隨著在地與道上獲得越來越高的證悟，你最終將獲得不可思議的功德，也就是二資糧無與倫比的果位──具足佛陀相好的色身，以及作為無垢本初智精髓的法身。

src_lines: Now pray before the supreme field of merit for the fulfillment of your goals.
lines: 現在，在殊勝的福田前祈願，祈求實現你的目標。

src_lines: NAMO
Buddha, Dharma, Sangha, and
Guru, deity, dakinis,
Protectors, wealth gods, treasure lords—
From the one primordial wisdom essence,
The nature, unimpeded, shows protean forms.
Wondrous compassion and activity!
To you, refuge and guardians of all beings,
Embodiments of love and wisdom, I
Pay homage and in earnest go for refuge.
I offer you my body and my wealth
And pray that you compassionately guard
Myself and endless beings at all times.
Please pacify disease and injury,
Increase longevity and merit, and
Bless me to accomplish all my wishes
In accordance with the holy Dharma.

Namo means homage. The Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha are the Three Jewels. The guru shows you what to accept and what to reject, so you should know that he has the supreme qualities of wisdom and love. The so-called tutelary deity or yidam is also referred to as the personal deity in whose body the buddhas and bodhisattvas have arisen. The dakinis are companions in accomplishing the Dharma, yoginis endowed with mundane and supramandane realization and power who accomplish activities. The protectors who guard the holy Dharma and delight in virtue; the gathering of yaksha wealth gods who grant the siddhi of wealth, and the treasure lords who guard hidden Dharma texts, articles, and wealth are all one within the essence, dharmadhatu, the primordial wisdom of suchness. Their nature or aspect is unimpeded, and they are endowed with supreme compassion, power, and enlightened activity, which display all kinds of form bodies.
lines: Namo 意為頂禮。佛陀、正法與僧伽是三寶。上師為你開示取捨之道，因此你應當了知他具足智慧與慈愛的殊勝功德。所謂的守護神或本尊，也被稱為諸佛菩薩化現其身的個人專屬本尊。空行母是成就正法的伴侶，是具足世間與出世間證悟及能力、能成辦事業的瑜伽母。守護聖正法且喜愛善法的護法；賜予財富成就的夜叉財神眾，以及守護隱密法教、聖物與財富的伏藏主，在精髓、法界、真如本初智中皆為一體。他們的自性或相貌無礙，具足殊勝的悲心、能力與事業，能展現出各種色身。

src_lines: Therefore pay homage and go for refuge wholeheartedly to them who are the refuge and protectors of all beings, who possess the wisdom of knowledge and measureless love and compassion. Offering your own and others' bodies, wealth, and roots of virtue, pray one-pointedly, “Always protect limitless sentient beings, especially my sponsors and all those connected to me, never letting them leave the sheltering wall of your compassion. Please quell all adverse circumstances, obstacles, and harm, and increase all favorable circumstances such as longevity and merit, wealth and fortune, glory and wisdom, faith and compassion. Please grant all my wishes without exception. Please grant me the blessing of accomplishment consistent with the Dharma, separate from bad karma and non-virtuous thoughts and deeds.”
lines: 因此，應向身為一切眾生依怙與守護者、具足了知的智慧與無量慈愛與悲心的他們，全心全意地頂禮並皈依。供養自他的身體、財富與善根，專一地祈請：「恆常守護無量眾生，特別是我的施主與所有與我結緣者，永遠不讓他們離開你的慈悲護牆。懇請平息一切逆境、障礙與傷害，並增長壽命與福德、財富與福運、榮耀與智慧、信心與悲心等一切順境。懇請實現我的所有願望，毫無遺漏。懇請賜予我契合於正法的成就加持，遠離惡業與不善的思惟及行為。」

src_lines: Then you make the three mandala offerings to Holy Tara and recite the praise. To start with, meditate on yourself as Holy Tara. When giving rise to the divine body, with your mind you envision that your body is not an ordinary body as it is now, but the body of the deity. There are two ways of doing this meditation. One is to meditate on the seed syllable, throne, and so forth in stages. The other is to create the visualization all at once, in an instant. Here we will follow the simultaneous method.
lines: 接著，應向聖度母獻上三次曼達並念誦禮讚文。首先，應觀想自己為聖度母。在生起尊身時，心中應觀想自己的身體不再是現在的凡夫身，而是本尊的身體。進行這種觀想有兩種方式。一種是按次第觀想種子字、法座等；另一種是在一瞬間同時生起觀想。在此，我們將採用同時生起的方法。

src_lines: First, purify your reification of the aggregates, dwelling place, and so on into emptiness. If this focal point of emptiness is stable, it will be very easy to meditate on the body of the deity. Although kriya tantra has the generation of the deity's body, it is said that this is not an authentic generation stage practice. But I will explain the general idea a bit here. In the context of meditation, the generation stage is typically explained in terms of three kinds of purity. The first is called “firm pride.” Whichever deity you are meditating on, firm pride is to think, when envisioning it, that you actually are that deity. The purity of “vivid aspects” is to envision clearly the deity's face, hands, and jewelry all together without getting them mixed up. Last of all, “perfect recall” means that once you know the reasons and need for all the jewelry and attire on the deity's body, you stay mindful of their significance. For example, deities of wrathful aspect are for taming cruel and hateful beings, animal-headed ones are the antidote that tames deluded beings, etc. You should know which of these are meant for taming which kinds of beings. Even if you cannot get the face, hands, and so on of the deity very clear, it is still appropriate to meditate with conviction[^8]. The point of meditating on the divine body is not just to receive blessings, it is mainly to purify from your mindstream your afflictions and attachment to the appearance of the ordinary world and its inhabitants, as well as to accomplish the Buddha's future form body.
lines: 一開始，將你對蘊、住處等的實執淨化為空性。如果這個空性的所緣堅固，觀想本尊身就會非常容易。儘管事部有生起本尊身，但據說這並非真正的生起次第修法。但在此我將稍微解釋一下其大意。在禪修的脈絡中，生起次第通常會以三種清淨來解釋。第一種稱為「堅固的佛慢」。無論你觀想的是哪一尊本尊，堅固的佛慢就是要在觀想時，認為自己實際上就是該尊本尊。「清晰行相」的清淨，是指將本尊的面容、手臂與飾品全部一起清晰地觀想出來，而不混淆。最後，「圓滿憶念」意味著，一旦你了知本尊身上所有飾品與衣著的緣由與必要性，你就要對其意義保持憶念。例如，忿怒相的本尊是為了調伏殘暴與瞋恨的眾生，獸頭本尊則是調伏愚癡眾生的對治法等等。你應當了知其中哪些是為了調伏哪一類眾生。即使你無法將本尊的面容、手臂等觀想得非常清楚，懷著勝解來禪修依然是適當的[^8]。觀想本尊身的目的不只是為了領受加持，主要是為了從你的心續中淨除煩惱，以及對平庸器情世間顯相的執著，並成就佛陀未來的色身。

src_lines: Instantly upon recalling I
Appear in Holy Tara's form complete.
A green-hued TAM is on the moon at my heart.
Then from the TAM spread boundless rays of light,
Inviting to the space in front of me
The twenty-one Arya emanations
And an oceanic cloud of Jewels.
lines: 心間月輪上有綠色 TAM
復從 TAM 散發無量光芒

src_lines: After purifying all phenomena of subject and object into emptiness, then, from that state of emptiness, as soon as you recall her, you instantly arise as the completely perfect body of Holy Tara. Tara, the embodiment of all the enlightened activities of the Victorious Ones of the three times, is green, the color of all-accomplishing wisdom. She has one face and two arms. Her lovely face is smiling and the sweet smell of utpala flowers wafts from her mouth. Her right hand forms the mudra of supreme generosity, for she protects sentient beings who have faith and pray to her from conflict and distress—from all fears. Her left hand, resting at her heart, holds the stem of an utpala with the thumb and ring finger; its petals in full bloom rest in front of her ear. Her body, sixteen years of age, is adorned with the major and minor marks. She sits in the charmed posture[^9]. A pair of round, full breasts adorns her chest. She wears all kinds of jewelry—earrings, a crown, etc.—a blue upper garment, and skirts of various kinds of silk. Her black hair gleams with oil. She sits with legs uncrossed; her right leg extends forward a bit, while her left is drawn in. Behind her is draped a vast, full, white moon. A green letter TAM is above the moon's seat at her heart. From it multicolored rays of light spread infinitely, their tips like bent metal hooks. With these tips they pull into the space before you the twenty-one Holy Taras as well as the buddhas and bodhisattvas of all directions and times—an ocean of the Three Jewels like a thick cloud bank.
lines: 將能所的一切現象淨化為空性之後，接著，從那空性狀態中，你一憶念起她，便瞬間生起為完全圓滿的聖度母尊身。度母是三世勝者一切佛行事業的化現，身呈綠色，這是成所作智的顏色。她一面二臂。嬌美的面容帶著微笑，口中散發著烏巴拉花的芬芳。她的右手結勝施印，因為她保護具信並向她祈請的眾生免於衝突與苦難──免於一切恐懼。她的左手安放於心間，以拇指與無名指持著烏巴拉花莖；盛開的花瓣齊於她耳前。她身如十六歲少女，具足諸相隨好莊嚴。她以嬌媚的坐姿安坐[^9]。一對圓潤豐滿的雙乳莊嚴著胸前。她佩戴著各種珠寶飾品──耳環、寶冠等──穿著藍色上衣與各種絲綢製成的下裙。她的黑髮油亮生輝。她雙腿未交疊而坐；右腿微伸，左腿踡曲。背後襯著一輪廣大圓滿的白月。心間的月座之上有著綠色 TAM 字。五彩光芒從中無限散發，光芒頂端宛如彎曲的鐵鉤。藉由這些光端，將二十一尊聖度母，以及十方三世諸佛菩薩──猶如厚重雲聚般的三寶海──勾招至你前方的虛空中。

src_lines: Then pray with single-minded faith and yearning:
lines: 接著，帶著專一的信心與渴望祈請：

src_lines: TAM
In the dharma body's unborn, lucid sphere,
In the Arya's unimpeded wisdom body,
Dawns an illusory web for taming beings
Come hither to me! ARYA TARE DZAH!
lines: 降臨我此處 ARYA TARE DZAH。

src_lines: TAM is the life-force mantra of Tara's name. It has the sense of calling out, “Oh Tara!” From the ultimate, unborn dharmadhatu, the sphere of the dharma body, Tara emerges in her unimpeded, compassionate, conventional form body or wisdom body[^10], the union of appearances and emptiness, an illusory web to tame beings according to their inclinations, dispositions, and so forth. Call on the wisdom body in the same form as you were meditating on earlier, praying for it to come to the place where you are. ARYA TARE DZAH is meant as an invitation to Tara. If you pray in this way to the personal deities, calling their names with single-minded faith and yearning, it is their nature to come, just as, for example, your friends will come quickly if you call their names.
lines: TAM 是度母聖號的命咒。它帶有呼喚「噢，度母！」之意。從勝義、無生的法界──法身之界中，度母顯現為她無礙、慈悲、世俗的色身或智慧身[^10]，這是顯空雙運、隨順眾生之意向與根器等以調伏眾生的幻化網。應呼喚如你稍早所觀想之相同形相的智慧身，祈請其降臨你所在之處。ARYA TARE DZAH 是迎請度母之意。如果你以此方式向本尊祈請，帶著專一的信心與渴望呼喚他們的名號，他們的本性便是會降臨，就像當你呼喚朋友的名字時，他們會迅速前來一般。

src_lines: Out of love for me and wanderers
And by the force of magical display,
Remain here, Blessed One, I pray,
For as long as I make offerings to you.
PEMA KAMALA SATAM

Pray that Arya Tara, the Blessed One, will think of you and all wandering sentient beings and, out of tremendous love and by the power of her bodhicitta, aspirations, and magical display, will stay and partake of your offerings for as long as you continue to make them so that you may perfectly complete the accumulations of merit and wisdom.
lines: 應祈請世尊聖度母顧念你與一切流轉的眾生，出於極大的慈愛，並藉由她菩提心、祈願與神變幻化的力量，只要你繼續獻供，她便會安住並享用你的供品，以便你能完全圓滿福德與智慧二資糧。

src_lines: PEMA KA MA LA SATAM being a mantra of prayer to remain, when you recite it, imagine that Tara gladly remains with you.
lines: PEMA KA MA LA SATAM 是祈請安住的咒語，當你念誦時，應觀想度母歡喜地與你同在。

src_lines: OM
I completely fill the dharmadhatu
With Samantabhadra's cloud of offerings
Both material and mind-arisen,
And offer them to Tara and her retinue.
OM ARYA TARE SA PARI WARA BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A
LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA WI DYA / SHAB DA TRA TI TSA SOHA
lines: OM ARYA TARE SA PARI WARA BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A
LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA WI DYA / SHAB DA TRA TI TSA SOHA

src_lines: OM means protection and blessing. Actual offerings of flowers, incense, butter lamps, and such; the entire wealth of the vessel of the outer world and its contents, sentient beings; offerings imagined and emanated with your mind—a cloud of Samantabhadra's offerings created through the power of aspiration and samadhi: All these fill the dharmadatu—that is to say, are infinite. So imagine filling all of space with them and giving them to Arya Tara and her retinue while uttering the offering mantras. As for the meaning of the mantras, ARYA TARA means Noble Tara. SAPARIWARA means “together with her retinue.” ARGHAM is water for drinking. PADYAM is bathing water, PÜKPE flowers, DHÜPE incense, ALOKE butter lamps, GENDE scented water, NEWIDYA food, and SHABTA music. TRATITSA means, “Please accept these offerings.”
lines: OM 意指保護與加持。實際陳設的花、香、酥油燈等供品；外在器世間與內在情世間眾生的全部財富；由你的心所觀想與化現的供品──透過祈願與三摩地的力量所創造的普賢供養雲：所有這一切皆遍滿法界──也就是說，是無量無邊的。因此，在念誦供養咒時，應觀想以這些供品遍滿一切虛空，並將它們供養聖度母與其眷屬。至於咒語的意義，ARYA TARA 意指聖度母。SAPARIWARA 意指「與其眷屬」。ARGHAM 是飲水。PADYAM 是沐浴水，PÜKPE 是花，DHÜPE 是香，ALOKE 是酥油燈，GENDE 是香水，NEWIDYA 是食物，而 SHABTA 是音樂。TRATITSA 的意思是「請納受這些供品」。

src_lines: OM AH HÜNG
I offer you all, essence of compassion,
The wealth of three realms, vessel and its contents,
My body, all my wealth and store of virtue.
I pray you, take them and your blessings give.
OM SARWA TATHAGATA RATNA MANDALA PÜ DZA HO
lines: OM SARWA TATHAGATA RATNA MANDALA PÜ DZA HO

src_lines: OM AH HÜNG signifies offerings pleasing to Tara's body, speech, and mind. You offer all the wealth and fortune of the outer vessel of the world and its three realms—the desire, form, and formless realms—and of the inner contents, sentient beings, to Holy Arya Tara, whose nature is wisdom and love, together with her retinue. Offer also your body, wealth, and all your gathered virtue. Pray that, accepting your offering, she will give her blessings to you and other beings out of the vast love she bears for you all. The mantra OM SARWA TATHAGATA RATNA MANDALA PÜDZA HO means, “Please accept and be delighted in this precious mandala which I offer to you, Thus Gone, Blessed, Holy Tara and all buddhas and bodhisattvas.”
lines: OM AH HÜNG 意指令度母身、語、意歡喜的供品。你將外在器世間及其三界──欲界、色界與無色界──以及內在情世間眾生的所有財富與福報，供養給自性為智慧與慈愛的聖度母及其眷屬。也供養你的身體、財富以及你所累積的一切善根。祈願她在納受你的供養後，出於對你們一切眾生的廣大慈愛，將加持賜予你與其他眾生。咒語 OM SARWA TATHAGATA RATNA MANDALA PÜDZA HO 的意思是：「如來、世尊、聖度母以及一切諸佛菩薩，請納受我所供養的這個珍貴曼達，並生起歡喜。」

src_lines: Then, having offered the first mandala, give praise to the twenty-one Taras. There are two praises to the twenty-one Taras. The first is the king of praises, which celebrates in twenty-one homages Holy Tara's qualities of body, speech, and mind as well as her enlightened activities. The second praises the twenty-one Taras individually. As you recite the praise, keep in mind that here you are mainly praising Green Tara in twenty-one homages. Recite it twice, then make the general offering again, beginning with “OM I completely fill the dharmadhatu . . . .” and going through the specific offering of the mandala that begins with “OM AH HUNG I offer you all . . . .” while understanding these verses as having the same meaning as before.
lines: 接著，在供養第一次曼達之後，讚頌二十一度母。讚頌二十一度母的禮讚文有兩種。第一種是禮讚文之王，以二十一次頂禮來讚頌聖度母的身、語、意功德以及她的佛行事業。第二種是分別讚頌二十一位度母。念誦禮讚文時，應銘記此處主要是以二十一次頂禮來讚頌綠度母。念誦兩遍後，再次進行一般供養，從「OM 我將法界全遍滿……」開始，接著進行從「OM AH HUNG 大悲自性我悉供……」開始的特定曼達供養，同時應了解這些偈頌與之前的意義相同。

src_lines: Her right hand, in the supreme giving mudra,
Changes to the refuge-granting mudra.
Gathering beneath it, I and all
Those guarded find relief from every fear.

Holy Tara's right hand, which is in the mudra of supreme giving, changes to the refuge-granting mudra. You and all those who are to be guarded gather there with the crowns of your heads placed beneath her hand, thereby gaining protection from all fears of fire, water, poison, weapons, sickness, evil spirits, every type of obstacle, the sufferings of samsara and those of the lower realms, and every kind of harm. Then, thinking that by receiving her protection you have found a joyful sense of relief, recite the twenty-one homage praise three more times.
lines: 聖度母結勝施印的右手，轉為賜予皈依印。你與所有受護眾生聚集於此，將頭頂置於她的手印下方，藉此獲得保護，免除來自火、水、毒、武器、疾病、邪靈、各種障礙、輪迴與下三道之苦，以及各種傷害的一切恐懼。接著，觀想因獲得她的保護而感到喜悅與寬慰，再念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》三遍。

src_lines: Once again, recite “OM I completely fill the dharmadhatu . . . .” and make the third mandala offering, “OM AH HUNG I offer you all. . . .” thinking them to have the same meaning as before. Then:
lines: 再次念誦「OM 我將法界全遍滿……」，並進行第三次曼達供養：「OM AH HUNG 大悲自性我悉供……」，同時觀想其意義與之前相同。接著：

src_lines: A stream of nectar flows down from her body,
And enters through my own crown and the crowns
Of all the beings under her protection,
Filling up our bodies with her blessings.

A stream of very pure nectar, white in color, flows down from the tip of the big toe of Holy Tara's right foot. This stream, which is of the nature of blessing and compassion, falls and enters through the crown of your head and through the crowns all others under her protection. It cleanses and purifies all illnesses, spirits, misdeeds, and obscurations of the body; they leave your body and dissolve into the ground below. This nectar of blessing and compassion fills your body, and the blessings of Holy Tara's body, speech, and mind enter your mindstream. Meditating thus, recite the praise to the twenty-one Taras seven times.
lines: 一道極為清淨的白色甘露流，從聖度母右腳大拇趾尖流下。這道自性為加持與慈悲的甘露流，降下並從你以及所有其他受護眾生的頭頂進入。它洗淨並淨化身體的一切疾病、邪靈、惡業與障礙；它們離開你的身體，消融入下方的地底。這加持與慈悲的甘露盈滿你的身體，聖度母身、語、意的加持也進入你的心續。如此觀想，念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》七遍。

src_lines: The learned who respect the goddess fully
When rising first at the dawn, again at dusk,
Will make this recitation from the heart
And, calling her to mind, find fearlessness.
Thereby their misdeeds will be pacified,
Thereby their lower births will be destroyed.

With full faith and devotion for the goddess Tara, recite her praises and her mantra, not just mouthing the words but with an attitude of single-minded faith. “When rising first at dawn, again at dusk . . . and, calling her to mind . . . ” means calling to mind her bodily aspect, her speech or mantra, and her mind or wisdom which is knowing, loving, and powerful. At dusk, recall her wrathful form, her peaceful form at dawn. If only you call her to mind and pray to her, illnesses, spirits, untimely death, fire, water, and all such obstacles and fears of this life will be pacified, and you will be given total fearlessness. Your misdeeds, the cause of being born in lower realms in future lives, will be utterly quelled. “Their lower births will be destroyed” means that, from birth to birth, in future lives you will not be born in the lower realms.
lines: 帶著對度母十足的信心與虔敬心，念誦她的讚文與咒語，不要只是有口無心地念，而應抱持專一的信心。「破曉晨起及向晚……憶念度母……」意指憶念她的身相、她的語或咒語，以及她具足智、悲、力的心或智慧。在向晚時，憶念她的忿怒相；在晨起時，憶念她的寂靜相。只要你憶念她並向她祈請，疾病、邪靈、非時死、水火災等此生的一切障礙與恐懼，都將得以平息，你將獲得完全的無畏。成為未來世投生惡趣之因的罪業，也將被徹底平息。「盡滅一切惡趣生」意指在未來的生生世世中，你都不會投生於惡趣。

src_lines: And they will quickly get empowerments
From seven times ten million conquerors
And thus accomplish greatness and proceed
Unto the final state of buddhahood.
Its poisons, intense and terrible are
In the environment and in beings.
All, whether eaten or even imbibed,
Are remedied through mindfulness of her.
The host of painful sufferings brought about
By spirits, epidemics, and poisons
Will be dispelled for others and themselves.

Arya Tara, as well as seventy million, that is many many buddhas and bodhisattvas who come simultaneously, will quickly bless and give empowerments and prophesies to practitioners. In this current life you will have abundant common and uncommon qualities, such as long life and merit, followers and disciples, fame and glory, hearing, pondering, meditation, and so on. You will quickly proceed through the grounds and paths in stages and soon reach the state of buddhahood.
lines: 聖度母，以及七千萬（也就是同時降臨的無數諸佛菩薩），將速疾加持行者，並賜予灌頂與授記。在此生中，你將具足豐盛的共同與不共功德，例如長壽與福德、追隨者與弟子、名聲與榮耀，以及聞、思、修等。你將速疾次第地行經地道，並迅速臻至佛地。

src_lines: There are tremendously cruel poisons that can disrupt you from reaching this goal. The main poison is wrong view, exemplified by the afflictions that get in the way of attaining of liberation and the obscurations of the knowable that get in the way of attaining omniscience. Then there are the poisons in the environment—in the water, plants, and so on. There are also poisons carried by sentient beings, such as snakes and animals with poisonous fangs, stingers, or evil spirits' poisons of sight, contact, and thought, as well as artificial poisons which are placed in food or drink. All of these poisons can be remedied by turning your mind to Tara and her mantra. Moreover, all the sufferings of pain from malignant spirits, being stricken by severe plagues, or poisons both inner and outer will be completely dispelled or eliminated. The same benefits will come to anyone else who praises or prays to Tara for the benefit of other beings.
lines: 有些極其狠毒的毒物會阻礙你達成此一目標。主要的毒物是邪見，其代表為阻礙證得解脫的煩惱，以及阻礙證得遍知的所知障。其次是環境中的毒物──存在於水、植物等之中。還有有情眾生所帶的毒物，例如蛇與長有毒牙、毒刺的動物，或是邪靈的視線毒、接觸毒與意念毒，以及被摻在飲食中的人工毒物。只要將心轉向度母與她的咒語，就能對治所有這些毒物。此外，惡靈所致的痛苦、染上嚴重瘟疫，或是內外毒物所帶來的一切苦痛，都將被徹底驅除或消滅。任何為了利益其他眾生而讚頌或祈請度母的人，也將獲得同樣的利益。

src_lines: Reciting clearly two, three, seven times,
Who wishes for a son will have a son,
And they who wish for wealth, too, will have wealth,
Indeed, they will have all that they desire,
And obstacles will each be smashed to naught.

In this ritual, you first recite Twenty-One Praises to Tara twice, later three times, and finally seven times. Other texts explain this as follows: Twice means both day and night. Three times means three times during daytime—in the morning, noon, and afternoon—and three times at night—at dusk, midnight, and just before daybreak. Seven times means that in each of these sessions you recite the Twenty-One Praises seven times clearly and with single-minded faith and veneration. By praising in this way, if you are a family holder who wishes for sons, you will have sons. If you are a Dharma lineage holder who wishes for disciples, you will have disciples. If you wish for wealth and possessions, you will obtain them in abundance easily. You will, moreover, have all ultimate and short-term desires, be they good business, a husband or wife, or other such things, or else the activities of pacifying, enriching, magnetizing, and subjugating, or the common or supreme siddhis. Any new obstacles that get in the way of your desires will be annihilated, and the old ones will be smashed without remnant by Holy Tara's compassion. Because the Twenty-One Praises is like the wish-fulfilling jewel that achieves all purposes and because it has infinite benefits, it stands to reason that all fortunate people who wish for the welfare of themselves and others should apply themselves to reciting it with faith, conviction, enthusiasm, and effort.
lines: 在這部儀軌中，你首先念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》兩遍，接著三遍，最後七遍。其他典籍對此的解釋如下：「二」是指白天與夜晚。「三」是指白天的三個時段──早晨、中午與下午──以及夜晚的三個時段──黃昏、午夜與黎明前。「七」是指在每一個修法座次中，你皆以專一的信心與恭敬心，清晰地念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》七遍。透過這樣的讚頌，如果你是期盼求得男丁的成家者，你將會獲得男丁。如果你是期盼擁有弟子的法脈持有者，你將會獲得弟子。如果你欲求財富與資財，你將能輕易且豐盛地獲得。此外，你將實現一切究竟與暫時的願望，無論是生意興隆、求得丈夫或妻子、或其他諸如此類的事物，或者是息、增、懷、誅的事業，乃至共同或殊勝的成就。任何阻礙你達成願望的新障礙都將被消滅，而舊有的障礙也將被聖度母的悲心粉碎無餘。由於《二十一度母禮讚文》如同能成辦一切目的的如意寶，且具有無量的利益，因此理所當然地，所有期盼自他福祉的有緣者，都應該帶著信心、確信、熱忱與精進致力於念誦。

src_lines: Next, sprinkle the torma with the purifying water and recite the mantra of the wrathful Amrita Kundali, which purifies obstacles and grants blessings.
lines: 接下來，以淨水灑淨食子，並念誦能清淨障礙與賜予加持的忿怒甘露漩明王咒語。

src_lines: OM BENZA AMRITA KÜNDALI HANA HANA HÜNG PET
lines: OM BENZA AMRITA KÜNDALI HANA HANA HÜNG PET

src_lines: Then recite:
OM SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO SAR WA DHARMA SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO HAM
lines: OM SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO SAR WA DHARMA SO BHA WA SHÜD DHO HAM

src_lines: With this mantra imagine that the torma is purified into emptiness without reference point.
lines: 藉由這個咒語，觀想食子被清淨為無所緣的空性。

src_lines: From emptiness's state the letter OM,
From OM a vessel precious, vast, supreme,
Within, the torma rises from three seeds,
Becomes the nectar of untainted wisdom.

Meditate this way: From the state in which the torma has transformed into nonconceptual emptiness, the letter OM appears clearly and then becomes a vast, precious torma tray. Within this vessel the three seed syllables OM AH HUNG melt into light, from which arises the torma. The torma, its nature now purified, transformed, and increased, turns into the nectar of primordial wisdom.
lines: 應如是觀想：從食子轉化為無分別空性的狀態中，OM字清晰顯現，接著變成一個廣大珍貴的食子盤。在此容器內，OM AH HUNG三個種子字化光，從中生起食子。食子的本質現在已被清淨、轉化與增長，變成本初智慧的甘露。

src_lines: OM AH HUNG
Utter the syllables three times, then recite the torma offering mantra thrice:
lines: 念誦這三個字三次，接著念誦供食子咒三次：

src_lines: OM ARYA TARE SAPARIWARA IDAM BA LINGTA KHA KHA KHAHI KHAHI
lines: OM ARYA TARE SAPARIWARA IDAM BA LINGTA KHA KHA KHAHI KHAHI

src_lines: ARYA TARE refers to Noble Tara. SAPARIWARA means “together with her retinue.” IDAM BA LINGTA means “this torma.” KHA KHA means “in the mouth.” KHAHI KHAHI means “Please accept, please accept.”
lines: ARYA TARE意指聖度母。SAPARIWARA意為「與其眷屬一起」。IDAM BA LINGTA意為「此食子」。KHA KHA意為「在口中」。KHAHI KHAHI意為「請接受，請接受」。

src_lines: OM AKARO MÜKAM SARWA DHARMA NAM ADYA NÜT PA NAN TOT TA
OM AH HUNG PHEY SOHA
lines: OM AKARO MÜKAM SARWA DHARMA NAM ADYA NÜT PA NAN TOT TA

src_lines: Reciting this three times, make the offering to the retinue and the guests.[^11] Then pray for the fulfillment of aims.
lines: 將此咒念誦三次，向眷屬與諸賓客獻供。[^11]接著祈求成辦所願。

src_lines: OM
With great primordial wisdom think
Of this pure torma offering,
And having partaken of great bliss
Pray grant all siddhis entirely.

Pray, “With your mind of powerful primordial wisdom, I pray you think of this torma which I have offered to the field of merit above and given to all the guests below; be delighted with it and partake of it with great, untainted bliss. I pray that you grant me the ultimate, the supreme siddhi of the attainment of liberation and the all-knowing state. And I pray that you grant me the temporary, common siddhis: long life, merit, glory, fame, and such, the powers of pacifying, enriching, magnetizing, and subjugating.” Having thus prayed, believe that you have obtained all siddhis.
lines: 祈請：「祈求以強大的本智心，垂念我向上方福田所供養、向下方一切賓客所佈施的此食子，對此生起歡喜，並以無漏大樂享用。祈求賜予我獲得解脫與遍知境界的究竟殊勝成就。並祈賜予我暫時的共通成就：長壽、福德、榮耀、名聲等，以及息、增、懷、誅的能力。」如此祈請後，應相信自己已獲得一切成就。

src_lines: As an expression of gratitude, make offerings and give praise.
lines: 為了表達感恩，應進行供養與讚頌。

src_lines: OM ARYA TARE SA PARI WARA BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A
LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA WI DYA / SHAB DA TRA TI TSA SOHA
lines: OM ARYA TARE SA PARI WARA BENZA ARGHAM / PA DYAM / PÜK PE / DHÜ PE / A
LO KAY / GEN DHE / NA WI DYA / SHAB DA TRA TI TSA SOHA

src_lines: Make offerings with drinking water, bathing water, flowers, incense, and so on.
lines: 以飲水、浴水、花、香等作供養。

src_lines: OM
Arisen from the face of Lokeshvara
Of Amitabha's lotus family,
The Lady of all buddhas' activities—
I prostrate and give praise to Arya Tara.

Here you pay homage to Arya Tara and, mindful of her qualities, praise her who embodies the enlightened activities of all the three times' buddhas and who sprang from the tears of Avalokiteshvara, the lord and protector of all worlds, of Buddha Amitabha's lotus family of enlightened speech.
lines: 在此，你向聖度母頂禮，憶念其功德而讚頌她：她體現了三世一切諸佛的事業，化生自阿彌陀佛語蓮華部、一切世間怙主觀世音菩薩的眼淚。

src_lines: I give praise with utmost faith
To them all who merit praise,
Bowing down to them with bodies
Numerous as this world's atoms.

Moreover, envisioning emanated bodies equal in number to the atoms in all the lands of the world, bow down humbly with your three doors to the praiseworthy conquerors and their heirs in every land, direction, and time. Praise them at all times and with utmost faith.
lines: 此外，應觀想化現出數量等同世間一切剎土微塵數的身體，以三門謙卑地向一切剎土、十方與三世中，所有應受讚頌的勝者及其佛子頂禮。在一切時中，皆以至極的信心讚頌他們。

src_lines: In prayer and aspiration, with ardent yearning and devotion, join your palms together:
lines: 在祈請與發願時，懷著熱切的渴慕與虔敬心，雙手合十：

src_lines: Holy Tara with your retinue,
Think of me with objectless compassion.
As I have prayed, bless me to achieve
My prayed-for purpose without obstacle.

Pray that the twenty-one Holy Taras and the gathering of buddhas and bodhisattvas, though they are free from the proliferation of referential concepts, will think of you lovingly, with great kindness and compassion Pray that they bless you to accomplish your entire purpose unhindered and in fulfillment of your wishes, just as you have prayed with single-minded faith and veneration.
lines: 祈請二十一聖度母與諸佛菩薩聖眾，雖然遠離了所緣概念的戲論，仍以大慈大悲慈愛地垂念你。祈請他們加持你，正如你以專一的信心與恭敬心所祈請般，無礙地成就你的一切目標，並圓滿你的願望。

src_lines: Then make the aspiration for the Buddha's teachings to spread.
lines: 接著，為佛陀教法的廣傳而發願。

src_lines: May Buddha's teaching grow and spread, its holders
Know harmony, their lotus feet be firm,[^12]
All harmful obstacles be pacified,
And the works of teaching and practice grow.
lines: 願佛陀教法增長廣傳與持教者

src_lines: May the all-knowing Conqueror's precious teachings, the source of all happiness and benefit, pervade and grow in the farthest reaches of all directions. The holders of the Dharma hold the three spheres: reading the Buddha's teaching, which is the sphere of hearing and pondering; relinquishment, which is the sphere of meditation; and action, which is the sphere of dharmic activity. May they exert themselves for the teachings and for the sake of sentient beings and be in harmony with one another; may their lives, their lotus feet, long be firm. Thereby may all harmful obstacles—both to the Dharma holders' activities that benefit the teachings and beings, and to your own and others' accomplishment of the Dharma—be pacified completely. May the activities of teaching and practicing the precious teachings grow more and more—the scriptures or so-called three baskets of the Vinaya, Sutra, and Abhidharma, and the path or three trainings of discipline, meditative absorption, and wisdom.
lines: 願一切利樂之源、全知勝者的珍貴教法，遍及並增長於十方極盡之處。持法者受持三輪：閱讀佛陀教法，此即聞思之輪；斷捨，此即禪修之輪；以及行動，此即佛法事業之輪。願他們為教法與眾生之利益而精進，且彼此和睦；願他們的壽命，即他們的蓮足，恆長堅固。藉此，願一切有害的障礙——無論是對持法者利益教法與眾生之事業的障礙，還是對你自己與他人成就佛法的障礙——皆完全平息。願講授與修持珍貴教法的事業日益增長——即經典或所謂的律、經、論三藏，以及道或戒、定、慧三學。

src_lines: Next is the aspiration for joy and happiness in this world.
lines: 接著，是為世間的喜悅與安樂而發願。

src_lines: May sickness, famine, war, and strife be quelled,
lines: 願疾病飢荒戰亂與紛爭皆平息

src_lines: The wealth of dharmic people greater grow,
The might of Dharma guardian kings increase,
And nations central and far-flung have joy.
lines: 具法者之財富更加增長
護法君王之威勢益增強
中土與邊遠諸國皆享喜樂。

src_lines: May diseases—sicknesses of wind, bile, and phlegm—and calamitous obstacles—hunger, thirst, poverty, and war—be pacified. May the wealth and fortune of all beings in this world grow greater and greater, especially that of all beings in lands where the sacred Dharma has spread and that of the faithful patrons of the teachings. May the might of the kings and ministers who guard the Dharma and have faith in its doctrines grow. May wanderers in all the vast nations east and west, central and outer, know happiness and peace of mind through love and kindness.
lines: 願疾病──風、膽、涎等疾病──以及災難障礙──飢餓、乾渴、貧窮與戰亂──皆平息。願世間所有眾生的財富與福報日益增長，尤其是正法廣傳之地的所有眾生，以及對教法具足信心的施主們。願守護佛法並對教理具足信心的君王與大臣們，威勢益增強。願東西方、中土與邊遠各個廣大國家的眾生，皆能透過慈愛而獲致喜悅與內心的寧靜。

src_lines: Next is the prayer for protection from fear and suffering.
lines: 接著，是祈求免於恐懼與痛苦的祈願。

src_lines: Protect me from all horrors present and future,
And from the sixteen fears, untimely death,
From nightmares and from evil omens,
Samsara's sufferings and lower realms.
lines: 護佑我免於現在未來一切恐懼
與十六種畏懼及非時之死
以及輪迴之苦與三惡道。

src_lines: Pray that you are protected from this present life's sufferings of body and mind, from the future horrors, both subtle and gross, of suffering in samsara, and from the sixteen fears of this life: fire, water, lions, elephants, snakes, flesh-eating demons, iron shackles, thieves, leprosy, famine, enemies, lightning, punishment by kings, separation from friends, failure, and evil spirits. Pray also for protection from portentous dreams, evil omens or signs during the daytime—in short, from every kind of inauspicious sign. Pray for protection in future lives from the sufferings of the lower realms of the hells, hungry ghosts, and animals.
lines: 應祈求護佑你免於今生身心的痛苦，免於未來輪迴中粗、細痛苦的恐懼，以及免於今生的十六種畏懼：火、水、獅、象、蛇、食肉魔、鐵銬、盜賊、痲瘋病、飢荒、怨敵、閃電、國王懲罰、親友分離、失敗以及邪靈。亦祈求護佑免於惡夢、白天的凶兆或惡相──總之，免於任何一種不祥之兆。祈求護佑在未來世免於地獄、餓鬼與畜生等惡道的痛苦。

src_lines: Then comes the particular aspiration for the generation of bodhicitta and so on.
lines: 接著，是關於生起菩提心等特定的發願。

src_lines: May long life, merit, power, and experience
And realization grow, unvirtuous thoughts not come;
May twofold bodhicitta rise in me without effort,
And grant my wishes in harmony with Dharma.
lines: 願壽命、福德、權力與覺受
及證悟增長，不生不善念
願二種菩提心毫不費力於我生起
並賜予成就如法之所願。

src_lines: May the short-term, worldly dharmas of longevity and merit, glory and fame, power and retinue— conditions agreeable to livelihood—grow in this life. Moreover, may the qualities, experience, and realization of hearing, pondering, and meditating on the sacred, transcendent Dharma be born in your mindstream and increase. May the unvirtuous thoughts of attachment, hatred, delusion, envy, pride, wrong view, and malicious intent to harm others never arise. In particular, may both precious relative bodhicitta of love and compassion and ultimate bodhicitta, which are yet unborn, be born in your mindstream without relying upon some immense effort. May that bodhicitta which has already been born not wither away, but increase more and more. In short, may all of your dharmic and worldly wishes be granted just as you wished them without going against the sacred Dharma, but acting in harmony with it.
lines: 願短暫的世間法，如長壽與福德、榮耀與名聲、權力與眷屬──這些適於生活的條件──能在今生增長。此外，願聞、思、修持神聖出世間法的功德、覺受與證悟，能在你的心相續中生起並增長。願貪、瞋、痴、嫉、慢、邪見，以及意圖傷害他人的惡意等不善念永不生起。尤其是，願尚未生起的、以慈與悲為本的珍貴世俗菩提心，以及勝義菩提心，能在不倚靠極大努力的情況下於你的心相續中生起。願已經生起的菩提心不退失，並日益增長。總之，願你所有佛法與世間的願望都能如你所願地實現，不違背神聖佛法，且與之相應。

src_lines: Next make the aspiration to never be separated from Holy Tara.
lines: 接著，發願永不與聖度母分離。

src_lines: From now until the essence of enlightenment,
Look on me inseparably with compassion's eyes
Just as a mother looks upon her only son.
I pray to be made indivisible from you.

Pray single-mindedly, “From now until I gain the state of enlightenment's essence, however long that takes, look on me with your eyes of compassion as inseparable from you during the six periods of day and night, just as a mother and father who have but one son would love and look after him. Temporarily act as my refuge and protector and ultimately for the sake of all sentient beings, I pray that you set me in buddhahood indivisibly from yourself, Arya Tara, and I too will perform the benefit of beings.”
lines: 應專心一意地祈請：「從今直至我獲得菩提藏的果位，無論需要多久，請於晝夜六時以悲眼不離地眷顧我，猶如父母慈愛並照顧獨子一般。暫時請作我的皈依處與保護者，而究竟而言，為了一切眾生，祈願將我安置於與聖度母無二無別的佛果中，我也將成辦利益眾生之事業。」

Me. Blessed as indivisible,

src_lines: Holy Tara and her retinue, whom you have envisioned before you, melt into light and dissolve into you. Because you are blessed as inseparable from Arya Tara's body, speech, and mind, you actually become the body of Arya Tara, appearing but not existent by nature, like a reflection in a mirror. Meditating thus, recite the ten syllable mantra as many times as possible while your mind is focused on envisioning the divine body.
lines: 你在前方所觀想的聖度母及其眷屬化為光，並融入你之中。因為你受到加持，與聖度母的身、語、意無二無別，你實際成為了聖度母的尊身，顯現而無實有自性，宛如鏡中之影。如此觀修，在心專注於觀想本尊身貌的同時，盡可能地念誦十字咒。

src_lines: OM TARE TÜTTARE TÜRE SOHA

This, the root mantra of Tara, is the queen of all awareness mantras. It bestows all attainments. Its meaning is this: OM means the possessor of the supreme siddhi, wealth and enjoyments, glory, prosperity, and luck; it means the promise to practice the mantra, protector, auspiciousness, and holder of wealth. It is the mantra that gives rise to all wants and needs. TARE TUTTARE is Tara's name. TÜRE means swift. SOHA means to pacify all misdeeds and obscurations, build up the accumulation of virtue higher and higher, eliminate the heap of faults and violations, and overcome all short and long-term suffering.
lines: 此度母根本咒是一切明咒之王后。它能賜予一切成就。其意涵如下：OM 意指殊勝成就、財富與受用、榮耀、繁榮與好運的擁有者；它也意指修持此咒的誓言、保護者、吉祥與持財者。這是能生起一切所欲與所需的咒語。TARE TUTTARE 是度母的名號。TÜRE 意指迅速。SOHA 意指平息一切惡行與障礙，使善德資糧越聚越高，消除積聚的過失與違犯，並克服一切暫時與長遠的痛苦。

src_lines: Here the text just says to focus on envisioning the divine body while reciting the mantra, but other texts say to envision that there is an eight-petaled utpala flower at Tara's heart center. On it is her life-force mantra, TAM, which is green in color. The ten syllable mantra, which faces inwards, is arranged clockwise around TAM and revolves counterclockwise. Green rays of light shine forth in all ten directions, making offerings to all the buddhas and bodhisattvas there. Their compassion and blessings merge within you. Then the rays of light once again shine forth and touch all the beings of the six realms, pacifying all their misdeeds, obscurations, faults, downfalls, sicknesses, demons, and obstacles. All sentient beings are Holy Tara's body, all realms her pure land, all appearances the deity, all sounds the mantra, all awareness primordial wisdom. It is good if you meditate on this while reciting the mantra. Moreover, I think it is also good if you can complete the visualization of the Vajrayana's four stakes that bind the life force[^13]. The four stakes are the view, the stake of dharmata; envisioning, the stake of the deity; reciting, the stake of mantra; and shining forth and converging, the stake of enlightened activity and blessing.
lines: 這裡的法本僅說在念誦真言時，將心專注於觀想本尊身貌，但其他法本提到，應觀想度母心間有一朵八瓣烏巴拉花。花上是她的命根字 TAM，顏色為綠。十字咒字面向內，順時針排列在 TAM 字周圍，並逆時針旋轉。綠色的光芒向十方放射，供養十方一切諸佛菩薩。他們的慈悲與加持融入你之中。接著，光芒再次放射並觸及六道一切眾生，平息他們所有的罪業、障礙、過失、墮罪、疾病、魔難與違緣。一切眾生皆是聖度母的尊身，一切世界皆是她的淨土，一切顯相皆是本尊，一切音聲皆是真言，一切覺性皆是本智。若能在念誦真言時如此觀修，那是很好的。此外，我認為若你能圓滿密乘中「繫縛命根之四釘」[^13]的觀想，也是很好的。這四釘為：見地即法性釘；觀想即本尊釘；念誦即真言釘；以及放光與收攝即事業與加持釘。

Complete, or otherwise I could not do,
And in whatever deeds I've erred herein,
It's suitable if you forbear them all.

Whatever offering materials you did not find, whatever visualizations, rituals, or mantras you failed to complete, the generation and completion stages, samayas, or siddhis you could not accomplish— whatever mistakes there are, acknowledge and confess them with all your heart. Pray that Arya Tara and the host of mandala deities have patience with them.

src_lines: OM
For sentient beings, you did everything,
Accordingly did you confer the siddhis.
I pray you go back to your buddhafield,
I pray that once again you will return.

Here you pray: “Arya Tara, you and your retinue did benefit to all us sentient beings with your blessings, helping us to amass the two accumulations and conferring the common and supreme siddhis according to the inclinations, aspirations, and merit of beings. Now having returned to your buddhafields, the Field Arrayed in Turquoise Petals etc., I pray that once again you will return for the sake of all sentient beings.”
lines: 這裡你祈請：「聖度母，你與眷屬以加持利益了我們所有眾生，幫助我們累積二資糧，並依據眾生的傾向、祈願與福德，賜予共同與殊勝成就。現在既已返回你們的佛土，如松石葉莊嚴佛土等，我祈請為了所有眾生，你們能再次降臨。」

This mantra means “I pray you come.”
