src_lines: Then with the following two lines, you, who have given rise to yourself as the deity, as well as your retinue and so on, all dissolve within the completion stage.
lines: 接著藉由以下兩句，將自身生起為本尊的你，以及眷屬等，皆消融於圓滿次第之中。

src_lines: I remain in the authentic state, the dharma sphere,
Inseparability of my mind and the deity's.

“I remain evenly within the mind's mode of being, the authentic primordial wisdom, the dharmadhatu, the inseparability of my mind and that of the supreme goddess Arya Tara, like water poured into water.” Thus maintain the view of the mode of being.
lines: 「猶如水入水般，我平等安住於心的實相、真實本智、法界，即我心與殊勝女神聖度母之心無二無別之中。」如此護持實相的見地。

src_lines: By this virtue, may I fast
Accomplish Arya Tara and
Establish beings in her state,
Not leaving even one behind.

“This virtue” signifies all your own and other's roots of virtue in the three times. So you ought to make the dedication and aspiration this way: “By the power of this virtue, having attained the state of Holy Arya Tara, may I also establish all wanderers in the state of the Holy Bhagavati without leaving even one behind.”
lines: 「此善」意指自他三世所有的善根。因此你應當如此作迴向與發願：「藉由此善根之力，願我於獲得聖度母果位後，亦能將一切眾生無一遺漏地安置於聖出有壞母之果位。」

src_lines: Then, when making the following the aspiration for auspiciousness, toss flowers in the air at “fortunate[^14].” Alternately, you may toss grains.
lines: 接著，在念誦以下的吉祥祈願時，於「有幸[^14]」處向空中拋灑花朵。或者，你也可以拋灑穀物。

src_lines: May we be fortunate to never part
From Holy Tara, conquerors, and heirs,
And lucky to be kept by their compassion
Who grant all wishes unimpeded, like
The good vase or the wish-fulfilling jewel.

“Day and night, at all six times, in this life and the next, and in the bardo, may we have the good fortune and virtue to never part from, and to be guarded and blessed by the tremendous love and compassion of, Holy Tara as well as the conquerors and their heirs, who, just by our praying to them, fulfill all our ends and wishes whatsoever without impediment, like the wish-fulfilling jewel that grants everything one wishes for just so, or like the good vase of vast treasure from which arises everything one might want or need.” Thus should you adorn the end of the sadhana beautifully.
lines: 「日夜六時、今生來世以及在中陰階段，願我們有幸與具足福德永遠不離聖度母與勝者佛子，並獲其巨大慈悲的守護與加持。我們只需向他們祈請，便能無礙地成辦一切目標與願望，猶如能如願賜予一切的如意寶，或是能生出一切所求所需的廣大寶藏之賢瓶。」你應當以此方式莊嚴地圓滿這部儀軌的結尾。

src_lines: In addition, the Great Master of Uddiyana said, “The view relates to scripture and reason. Meditation relates to experience. Conduct relates to time. Practice with these three relations.” Also, he has said, “The ultimate, the visualization, and the expression, the door of words.” This means to put into practice without separating the words and their meanings, the expressions (the ritual words) and their referents (the ritual stages of visualization and so on). You must practice with the certainty and belief that, whatever deity you are practicing, that very deity specifically is the essence of infinite buddhas. The tantra Compendium of Intent says, “To practice one deity is to accomplish all of the unpracticed ones. Therefore, exert yourself on one without accepting or rejecting. With a mind that accepts and rejects, even if you practice many deities you will accomplish not a single one, but only bring about fatigue.” Thus know in the context of practicing Holy Arya Tara, also, that if you practice with the thought that she is the essence of all the conquerors in space and time, by practicing one deity you will accomplish all of them.
lines: 此外，鄔金大師曾說：「見地與教理相關。禪修與覺受相關。行持與時間相關。應以這三種關聯來修持。」他也曾說：「勝義、觀想，以及表達的言詞之門。」這意味著在修持時，不應將言詞與其意義、表達（儀軌的言詞）與其指涉的對象（觀想等儀軌次第）分開。你必須帶著確信與信仰來修持：無論你修持哪一位本尊，該本尊本身即是無量諸佛的本質。《密意總集》密續中說道：「修持一位本尊，即是成就所有未修持的本尊。因此，應不取不捨地精進於一位本尊。若帶有取捨之心，即使修持諸多本尊，你也無法成就任何一位，只會徒增疲累。」因此應當知曉，在修持聖度母時也是如此，如果你在修持時抱持著她即是十方三世一切勝者之本質的想法，那麼藉由修持這一位本尊，你便能成就所有的本尊。

src_lines: I, the nomad-wanderer Tsultrim Namdak Pel Zangpo, otherwise known as Khenpo Tsulnam, composed this commentary to The Tara Ritual of Four Mandalas in my room in Lunrig Jampel Ling, the great monastic university of Palpung Sherab Ling-the exile seat of Vajradhara Kenting Tai Situ Rinpoche in the north of India, a place of solitude in the midst of a cedar forest at the foot of the Himalayas. I composed it, beginning on the auspicious holiday of Buddha's first turning of the Dharma wheel, in hopes of benefiting some beginners on the path with interest in this particular teaching. May this composition become a cause for the spread of the teachings, the long lives of the lineage-holders, and for all beings, having partaken of the joys of the ocean of dharmic wealth, to attain the ultimate state of Arya Tara, the mother the Victors.
lines: 我，游牧行者楚臣南達巴桑波，又名堪布楚南，於八蚌智慧林的大佛學院「倫日蔣貝林」的房內撰寫了這部《四曼達度母儀軌》釋論──此處是金剛持廣定大司徒仁波切在印度北部的流亡法座，位於喜馬拉雅山腳下雪松林中的一處寂靜地。我從佛陀初轉法輪的吉祥佳節開始撰寫此文，冀望能對一些對此特定教法感興趣的道上初學者有所裨益。願此著作能成為教法弘揚、傳承持有者長久住世之因，並願一切眾生在得享法財汪洋的喜悅後，皆能證得勝者之母──聖度母的究竟果位。

src_lines: Here the meanings of purification, transformation, and increase can be illustrated by the example of a flower. The offering of the flower is purified by OM, which cleanses any dirt or other mundane impurities as well as your own grasping at the intrinsic reality of the flower. src_lines: Clean your place of practice and make it pleasant. At first, if you have them, arrange representations of the Buddha's body, speech, and mind as a general support and, in particular, a statue or painting of Tara of good quality and correct proportions that has been consecrated. You should place on your altar a mandala made from precious metal, such as gold, silver, or copper, with a heap of grains. Although in this ritual of four mandala offerings it's said that one needs four mandalas, one for the Three Jewels in general and three to offer to Tara, one mandala will suffice for the practice. You should pleasantly and neatly arrange a kardum (a round, white torma made of the three whites[^3] and the three sweets[^4]), drinking water, water for washing feet, flowers, incense, butter lamps, scented water, food, musical instruments, and so on—whatever you can get. Likewise, collect other offerings, such as a parasol, victory banner, canopy, purification water, and grains to toss. As this practice is according to kriya tantra, you should bathe and keep things tidy and clean, if possible. If not, you should practice in the early part of the day when you have not yet been tainted by meat or alcohol.
lines: 打掃你的修法處並將其佈置得舒適宜人。首先，如果你有這些聖物，請陳設代表佛陀身、語、意的物品作為一般的所依，特別是一尊品質優良、比例正確且已開光的度母佛像或畫像。你應該在供桌上放置一個由金、銀或銅等貴金屬製成的曼達，以及一堆穀物。雖然在這個四曼達供養儀軌中，說到需要四個曼達，一個用於一般供養三寶，三個用以供養度母，但一個曼達就足以進行修持。你應該美觀而整齊地陳設一個嘎東（一種由三白[^3]與三甜[^4]製成的圓形白色食子（朵瑪））、飲水、濯足水、花、香、酥油燈、香水、食物、樂器等等──任何你能取得的供品。同樣地，備齊其他供品，例如傘蓋、勝幢、寶蓋、淨水，以及拋撒用的穀物。由於此修持依循事部，如果可以的話，你應該沐浴並保持整潔與清淨。如果無法做到，你應該在一天中較早的時間進行修持，此時你尚未沾染肉類或酒類。

src_lines: First you go for refuge with a single-minded attitude of faith and devotion. The gateway to all Buddhist paths is refuge. Particularly in the Mahayana tradition, the root of the path is the generation of bodhicitta. Therefore, in the beginning you should go for refuge and generate bodhicitta.

src_lines: Then you make the three mandala offerings to Holy Tara and recite the praise. To start with, meditate on yourself as Holy Tara. When giving rise to the divine body, with your mind you envision that your body is not an ordinary body as it is now, but the body of the deity. There are two ways of doing this meditation. One is to meditate on the seed syllable, throne, and so forth in stages. The other is to create the visualization all at once, in an instant. Here we will follow the simultaneous method.
lines: 接著，應向聖度母獻上三次曼達並念誦禮讚文。首先，應觀想自己為聖度母。在生起尊身時，心中應觀想自己的身體不再是現在的凡夫身，而是本尊的身體。進行這種觀想有兩種方式。一種是按次第觀想種子字、法座等；另一種是在一瞬間同時生起觀想。在此，我們將採用同時生起的方法。

src_lines: In this ritual, you first recite Twenty-One Praises to Tara twice, later three times, and finally seven times. Other texts explain this as follows: Twice means both day and night. Three times means three times during daytime—in the morning, noon, and afternoon—and three times at night—at dusk, midnight, and just before daybreak. Seven times means that in each of these sessions you recite the Twenty-One Praises seven times clearly and with single-minded faith and veneration. By praising in this way, if you are a family holder who wishes for sons, you will have sons. If you are a Dharma lineage holder who wishes for disciples, you will have disciples. If you wish for wealth and possessions, you will obtain them in abundance easily. You will, moreover, have all ultimate and short-term desires, be they good business, a husband or wife, or other such things, or else the activities of pacifying, enriching, magnetizing, and subjugating, or the common or supreme siddhis. Any new obstacles that get in the way of your desires will be annihilated, and the old ones will be smashed without remnant by Holy Tara's compassion. Because the Twenty-One Praises is like the wish-fulfilling jewel that achieves all purposes and because it has infinite benefits, it stands to reason that all fortunate people who wish for the welfare of themselves and others should apply themselves to reciting it with faith, conviction, enthusiasm, and effort.
lines: 在這部儀軌中，你首先念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》兩遍，接著三遍，最後七遍。其他典籍對此的解釋如下：「二」是指白天與夜晚。「三」是指白天的三個時段──早晨、中午與下午──以及夜晚的三個時段──黃昏、午夜與黎明前。「七」是指在每一個修法座次中，你皆以專一的信心與恭敬心，清晰地念誦《二十一度母禮讚文》七遍。透過這樣的讚頌，如果你是期盼求得男丁的成家者，你將會獲得男丁。如果你是期盼擁有弟子的法脈持有者，你將會獲得弟子。如果你欲求財富與資財，你將能輕易且豐盛地獲得。此外，你將實現一切究竟與暫時的願望，無論是生意興隆、求得丈夫或妻子、或其他諸如此類的事物，或者是息、增、懷、誅的事業，乃至共同或殊勝的成就。任何阻礙你達成願望的新障礙都將被消滅，而舊有的障礙也將被聖度母的悲心粉碎無餘。由於《二十一度母禮讚文》如同能成辦一切目的的如意寶，且具有無量的利益，因此理所當然地，所有期盼自他福祉的有緣者，都應該帶著信心、確信、熱忱與精進致力於念誦。

src_lines: This, the root mantra of Tara, is the queen of all awareness mantras. It bestows all attainments. Its meaning is this: OM means the possessor of the supreme siddhi, wealth and enjoyments, glory, prosperity, and luck; it means the promise to practice the mantra, protector, auspiciousness, and holder of wealth. It is the mantra that gives rise to all wants and needs. TARE TUTTARE is Tara's name. TÜRE means swift. SOHA means to pacify all misdeeds and obscurations, build up the accumulation of virtue higher and higher, eliminate the heap of faults and violations, and overcome all short and long-term suffering.
lines: 此度母根本咒是一切明咒之王后。它能賜予一切成就。其意涵如下：OM 意指殊勝成就、財富與受用、榮耀、繁榮與好運的擁有者；它也意指修持此咒的誓言、保護者、吉祥與持財者。這是能生起一切所欲與所需的咒語。TARE TUTTARE 是度母的名號。TÜRE 意指迅速。SOHA 意指平息一切惡行與障礙，使善德資糧越聚越高，消除積聚的過失與違犯，並克服一切暫時與長遠的痛苦。
